There is a lives system where the number of lives is reduced when the ball touches the bottom of the screen and a barrier system where the ball can touch a barrier at the bottom of the screen a number of times before it disappears, along with different difficulty levels. Both systems can also be played as multiplayer co-op. In that mode the second player is however more of a helper, as the paddle floats below the one of the first player and it can only catch balls that are missed by the first. There are different types of blocks where each colour holds a different amount of points, blocks that need to be hit multiple times, moving blocks, and blocks that are impenetrable. Optionally enemies can be activated (Obobo, Konerd, Triphere, Pyradok, Klacker, Valion). They float through the screen and need to be hit. There is also a boss level at the end of the game. Certain blocks release bonuses for the Vaus:* Laser: fire a laser at the blocks, acquiring another one provides a power laser.

Expand: increase the Vaus' size with 50%
Catch: catch the ball and release it whenever you want
Slow: slows down the speed of the ball
Reduce: halves the Vaus' size but gives double points
Megaball: the ball can break through blocks without bouncing
Disruption: seven clones of the ball appear (multiball)
Certain bonuses are only available according to the chosen system:* Lives Rules: + Break: an escape hatch to the rights open where you can leave the level to complete it + Thunder: a plasma shield appears below the Vaus to bounce back a lost ball once + Player Extension: extra life

Barrier Rules:
Warp: clears the current round
Barrier: increases the barrier strength by one, with a maximum of ten
Vanish: erase all blocks of the same colour as the one the ball touches next
The game can also be played against another player in the VS mode (split-screen) with two rules:* Bust All: the first player to bust all blocks wins

Bust Color: the first player to bust all blocks of a selected colour wins
All games in VS mode are played with the barrier rule system. In the VS mode four extra bonuses are available not present in the other modes of the game:* Slow: slows down the speed of the opponent's ball

Increase: create a number of normal blocks on the opponent's screen
Reduce: halves the size of the opponent's Vaus
Hard: creates a number of hard blocks on the opponent's screen

173116.overview:
What time is it? It’s time to crack a case!

Adventure Time: Finn and Jake Investigations is an all-new, story-driven graphic adventure game. Strange stuff is happening in the Land of Ooo (stranger than usual anyway). Luckily, Finn and Jake are on the case. This mysterious adventure will put their detective skills to the test as they search for clues, interrogate witnesses and piece together the evidence to save the day. They might even have to bust up a few goons along the way, but it’s nothing that Finn and Jake Investigations can’t handle!

Game Features:
• Sleuth your way through five cases set in the Land of Ooo, each of which plays out a separate chapter (like your own personal episode of the show).
• See the Adventure Time characters and familiar locations for the first time in 3D.
• Tackle puzzles by creatively using inventory objects and Jake’s shape-shifting abilities.
• Combat evildoers as Finn using a variety of unique swords and Jake’s awesome attack forms.

173117.overview:
All the princesses of the Nameless Kingdom have been kidnapped. Princess Bubblegum sends you, Finn, along with Jake to rescue them and decide which princess will commands the Nameless inhabitants in the Land of Ooo.

Adventure Time: The Secret Of The Nameless Kingdom is a top-down action-adventure game, reminiscent of The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past. Much like the Zelda games, your primary weapon is a sword and you primary defense is a shield. Instead of jars to store items in, you get plastic bags. Your sword can be upgraded within the game and you can acquire bombs and a ranged weapon to kill enemies as well as a boomerang that can stun enemies.

173118.overview:
Air Conflicts: Vietnam is an arcade-styled air-combat game that immerses players in the harrowing skies over Vietnam. Take to the air in screaming fighter jets or grab the controls of devastating helicopter gunships as you shatter enemy encampments with explosive ordinance, decimate North Vietnamese fighter squadrons, and deliver troops to the ever-changing front lines of the vicious battlefield.
KEY FEATURES
Live a thrilling wartime narrative. In an epic campaign, filled with heroic moments and the darker side of war
Jump into the cockpit for instant action. Pilot and customize more than 20 planes and – for the first time in the Air Conflict series – helicopters
Lead your squadron to victory. Command up to four jets or helicopters, maximizing their unique abilities to complete challenging objectives
Challenge your friends for air supremacy. Play up to 8 online opponents in nail-biting air battles.
Treat your ears to a cool rock soundtrack in the style of vintage Vietnam-era tunes.

173120.overview:
To Secure Peace You Must Prepare for War.
Command a squadron of fully customized Armored Core Units in a dystopian future ravaged by war and stripped of its natural resources The last remaining resources needed for the survival of your faction are scavenged and bitterly fought for in the No Man’s Land, a bleak landscape that offers little hope for survival. Enlist into one of the various in-game factions and strategically adapt your weapon systems to wrestle control of territories away from other players and establish a much needed peace. A heavy trigger finger, innovative customization and tactical teamwork will be all that stand between survival and total annihilation in ARMORED CORE™: VERDICT DAY™.

173121.overview: Attack of the movies 3-D is a first-person rail shooter that is based on stereoscopic 3D and contains four sets of 3D glasses along with the game. In the six different movie gameplay scenes players are put in mini-game-esque battles, each with a different theme. Players try to defeat large alien space cruisers in Cosmic Combat, and join the resistance against the machines and try to destroy the machine mainframe in Robot Rebellion. In each level, three weapons to use against the enemies of that genre are provided. For example, the quintessential zombie-slaying shotgun in the horror level; an automatic laser cannon in the science fiction level, etc. In multiplayer up to four players are supported simultaneously, with each player controlling a crosshair of a different colour. Typically for the genre, no movement is required as the camera glides around automatically.

173179.overview:
Crash Time is an action-oriented racing game based on the German TV series Alarm für Cobra 11. The main characters are the Semir Gerkhan and Chris Ritter, known from the series, and a novice policemen. Which one the player controls depends on the mission.

The campaign consists of 8 cases which are divided into several sections and are arranged in a linear way. The eight case has to be unlocked by beating most of the others in the highest difficulty. The goals of the sections are varying, mostly the player has to win a race or stopping a criminal by crashing his car or thwarting him. Other goals are checkpoint races or tailing somebody. The story is told voiced texts between the sections or in voiceovers during the missions. If the player fails a section he can try it again instantly but he has to solve the whole case in one sitting.

Most sections have additional goals which the player needs to fulfill, e.g. a time or damage limit. These restrictions change with the difficulty level which can be selected before each case. After every solved case the player unlocks new cars and courses for the single races and multiplayer mode. These don't represent the playing modes of the campaign but are always regular races.

173356.overview: Rugby video game, developed by Sidhe and published by Tru Blu Entertainment.

175269.overview:
Includes: 
Assassin's Creed II
Assassin's Creed Brotherhood
Assassin's Creed Revelations

The Truth is Written In Blood
Be A Legend
Two Assassins, One Destiny

This collection contains three discs, one for each game.

184821.overview: Akatsuki no Amaneka to Aoi Kyojin is a strategy game, developed by Kogado Studio and published by CyberFront, which was released in Japan in 2010.

186578.overview: Two of the all-time classic arcade games come to Xbox LIVE Arcade in Asteroids, Asteroids Deluxe, a combo of intense action where players must save earth from a deadly bombardment of asteroids. The full historic game is available in its original form, along with a completely re-stylized version featuring evolved graphics.

190270.overview: From indie Chilean developer ACE Team comes an Art Nouveau-styled, side-scrolling action adventure game featuring a complex fighting engine in procedurally generated levels that destine its three warriors to battle for an eternity. Enter the bold Katrien, the tortured specter Ghost Monk, and the ethereal Pincoya. Perform combos and chain attacks, and release a flurry of blows in order to survive what lies beneath. Your path into the unknown may start out with three fierce warriors, but when you learn to possess your enemies, you can challenge the abyss with their skills and combat abilities. Use these abilities available to you and attempt to figure out the infinite abyss. But the difficulties in accomplishing this great task don't end there! The side-scrolling levels never play out the same way twice, from the monsters they are filled with, to the locations of life-saving merchants, or the unique encounters and treasures to be found.

199450.overview: The game begins with the vampire Shuggy inheriting a haunted Scottish mansion from his grandfather. In order to make it a livable space he must evict the undesirable creatures currently living in it. To do so he must collect all the gems in a given room to acquire a key. The keys are spread across five areas: The Dungeon, The Boiler Room, The Gallery, The Graveyard and The Clocktower. Once all keys are obtained Shuggy can evict the evil tenants and claim his mansion.

199655.overview:
Control the fastest guns in space in Aces of the Galaxy, the non-stop, old-school arcade space-shooter for the 21st century. Utilize an impressive arsenal of upgradeable weapons including powerful missile launchers, devastating torpedoes and the ever-reliant chain gun to annihilate the rival Skurgian Empire ships.

- Temporal Shift: Intense feature slows down the hordes of enemies
- Stunning Visuals: Bring the action up close and personal
- 3rd Person Action: Retro-arcade shooter gameplay style

203831.overview:
Crash Time III is the seventh main game in the long-running German Alarm für Cobra 11 series. It is based on the German action police series of the same name that first aired in 1996. In this driving game players control a car with detectives Semir Gerkan, one of the original characters, and Ben Jäger who was first introduced in the TV series in the 24th season in September 2008.

The game is set in a large, living city that can be freely explored. The main career mode is centered around a terrorist attack on an international airport. Initially starting seven days before those events, Gerkan and Jäger drive around performing patrol duties until they get involved with the gangsters behind the attacks. Most of the missions are centered around tasks such as tailing, stopping and shooting suspects, escort missions and reaching destinations in time (including getting breakfast). Most of the missions have a time limit that can be extended a few times, but at the loss of star ratings that open up new options in the game.

There is a wide selection of cars that can be unlocked gradually, with different categories such as American Cobra, Cobra Special, Transporter, Road Chief, Race Car and Police Car. There are about 40 vehicles and they are rated based on top speed, acceleration and handling. Cars take damage and the detectives also need to pay for damage inflicted to property or other vehicles. Using the siren or the horn, the traffic will adjust its behaviour. While driving, a large arrow shows the general direction of the objective and the remaining distance. There is also a top-down road map that can be consulted. There are different precincts and many distinctive areas and buildings such as the airport, the highway, hotels, churches, hospitals and a harbour. All cars have a nitro option for additional speed, with a recharge time.

Next to the main career mode, there is also an option to do races against other cars and a split-screen multiplayer mode on a single computer for up to four players.

203832.overview: Experience Konami's first ever Microsoft Natal title with full body motion controls! Adrenalin Misfits thrusts gamers into 7 unbelievable fantasy worlds with exciting boarding battles in amazing environments. Compete in cross boarding action through freestyle, time and collection challenges against boss characters each with unique abilities. Battle Boss' from around the world growing your abilities and gaining more impressive boards each with their own special features. Win a race, steal that boss' board and do battle to collect all 60. Natal controls mean anyone can play because your body is the controller. The Natal camera reads your body's natural motions converting them into character actions on screen. It's not just a race, it's a battle!

206564.overview: Party-style fun is ripe for the picking as Apples to Apples the video game comes to Xbox LIVE Arcade! This game of hilarious comparisons is as simple as comparing apples to apples - just select the red card you think is most like the green card played by the judge. If the judge picks your card, you win the round. And everyone gets a chance to be the judge! Play online with up to 5 friends in Classic Mode or two variant modes - Baked Apples and Crab Apples! Choose from 26 hilarious Apple Avatars, enjoy environments like Space Apples and Carnival Apples, and collect Golden Apple Cards that mix up the game! Bursting with over 1000 red and green cards, Apples to Apples the video game provides endless hours of unpredictable, over-the-top fun!

209097.overview: Alien Rage is an action-packed, hard-core first-person shooter that will have you facing off against armies of the nastiest Alien forces ever encountered. Battle beastly-sized bosses relentlessly attacking you from every direction, hell-bent on taking you down. Tons of powerful dual-mode weapons, 14 intense levels, massive shootouts, destructible environments and over-the-top fast paced gameplay

209098.overview: After losing contact with his explorer friend Virgi, our fearless alien hero Spidy heads to Earth in his spacecraft to find her. While entering the Earth’s atmosphere, his spacecraft suddenly fails and starts to break up, causing Spidy to crash-land on the strange planet, with his craft scattered across forests, throughout ponds and into dark caves. Spidy finds himself alone on an alien world and faces the epic challenge of tracking down Virgi, battling strange new enemies and finding the missing pieces from his spacecraft in order to repair the damage and make their escape home.

209099.overview: Boom, headshot! You’re all that stands between 6 billion zombies and the world’s supply of delicious, supple head-candy. Guide up to four players through the town of Deadhill and blast your way through ranks of brain-hungry monsters, making bizarre weapons and completing crazy quests. Imagine non-stop action vs the fun bits of an RPG, including classes, levelling, crafting, loot and an unrelenting, undead army. So reload your shotguns and lock up your brains: All Zombies Must Die!

209100.overview:
Arkadian Warriors is a hack-and-slash fantasy dungeon crawler blending arcade and RPG elements. Heroes battle their way through a dungeon filled with monsters, traps, and treasure, with the ultimate goal of defeating the Gorgon. These heroes can temporarily transform into huge beasts that provide increased battle capability. The beasts include a phoenix, a lion and a dragon, depending on the class. This state can be acquired by battling enemies, which slowly fills up a meter. Players can also level up and gain additional experience, spells or skills.

The different classes include Soldier, Archer and Sorcerer. Players can go through the dungeons alone or enter an online cooperative game. The game's main location is the town hub, where the nineteen different quests, leading to Gorgon's defeat, are received. The game's longevity is added to by dynamically generated dungeons, changing the layout every time.

209101.overview: A multiplayer classic that resurrects the competitive spirit of arcade games from years gone by. Knock out the other kings in their castles while keeping yourself protected at the same time. Up to four players can join the action with the game taking control of any vacant castles allowing for a variety of single- or multiplayer experiences. The Evo mode even allows players to import their own pictures to their castles!

209102.overview: It's the year 3587; conflict spans the stars. Huge robot armies are locked in an enduring stalemate. In their bid for galactic conquest they call upon the most powerful group of mercenaries in the universe: the Awesomenauts! Play as one of several Awesomenauts and storm the online arenas alone or with friends. Each Awesomenaut can be upgraded with their own unique items to suit different strategies. Expect new items and Awesomenauts to be added regularly!

209103.overview:
Axel & Pixel is a point-and-click adventure video game developed by Silver Wish Games. The game was released on October 14, 2009 for the Xbox 360's Xbox Live Arcade service and on October 7, 2010 for Steam.

The game revolves around Axel, a painter, and his dog Pixel, who awake in a beautiful, yet perilous, dream world of Axel's own creation. Together, they must solve the mysteries of Axel's landscapes to get through the dream world by defeating the Ice Giant and helping Axel fulfill his greatest wish - to paint a picture of all four seasons in a single day.

Gameplay
The game is a traditional point-and-click adventure, where the player has to logically come up with answers and solutions to riddles and problems that are encountered during the course of the game. As a way of making Axel & Pixel unique from other point-and-click adventures, the cursor is made up of a group of glittering lights, which change colour slightly if the player lands the cursor on a point of interest. Aside from the traditional point-and-click mechanics, the game also features different platform mini-games (hot-air balloon through a cave, driving through the mountains, or sailing a boat downstream). The game also makes use of quick time events in a few of the chapters as ways of helping Axel scale walls or avoiding dangerous obstacles. The game is divided into four sections - in the form of the four calendar seasons - which are unlocked through natural progression of the story. Each of the mini-games featured are used once in story mode as ways of pursuing Evil Rat through the dream world, from the last chapter of the current calendar season into the beginning of the next one. Unlike most point-and-click adventures, Axel & Pixel contains no dialogue option between characters, in an attempt to keep the gameplay focused more on solving the puzzles instead of interactions. Axel, however, will speak gibberish to Pixel and to himself occasionally.

Plot
Axel & Pixel tells the story of a painter, Axel, and his dog, Pixel, as they embark on a fantastic journey through the surreal and dangerous dream world of Axel's own artistic creation after the two are hypnotised by a lullaby record. Upon entering the dream world, the primary antagonist, Evil Rat, is found to be in possession of the key which Axel needs to exit the dream world. The first chapter features the same snowy environment outside as in the real world - albeit, with an array of weird and wonderful creatures - but, upon completion of the chapter, the pair move into Spring, where the environments are very flowered, colourful and are inhabited by creatures such as giant honeybees, hard-shelled sheep and a plethora of insect species. Arriving at a derelict temple, Evil Rat destroys a large monument of a golden snake with a missile.

209104.overview: When Zeus, the legendary Greek God, brings you back to life, you set forth on a mission to rescue his daughter Athena from the underworld. Along the way, collect the Spirit Balls dropped by enemies to increase your strength and transform into a variety of mythical creatures with powerful attacks.

209105.overview: Get ready to stretch your grey matter as you put yourself through more than 100 interesting and challenging puzzles designed to stretch and train your brain in key areas including logic, language, visual and more. Mensa Academy is the only brain training game backed by Mensa, the high IQ society, so for the first time you’ll be able to put all that practice into action by taking on real Mensa-style questions, like the ones you see in the Mensa IQ tests. What will your Mensa Academy score be?

209106.overview: From the creators of 'Cloning Clyde' comes a new epic adventure! Eat, chant, dance, and even puke your way through the highly comical, primeval land of Ooga! There’s never a dull moment as you meet, befriend, and finally acquire seven zany Oogani tribes. Uncover their lost ancient powers, and exploit their abilities to lead them in a revolt against the tyrannical Boolis. Classic platforming/puzzle solving with a novel eat/carry/puke inventory management component. Over fifty amazing levels, excellent multiplayer, plus, narcotic slugs that make you loopy! Ancients of Ooga is sure to take you out of this world.

209107.overview: Set in an abandoned sawmill nestled high in the Italian mountains, Anna challenges the player to uncover horrific clues and use them to solve puzzles related to your character’s dark past. The player’s behavior does not only determine the mental health of the main character but can also change locations and unveil new secrets leading to one of eight possible endings.

217332.overview:
Assassin's Creed III: The Tyranny of King Washington - The Infamy is a DLC (download content) for Assassin's Creed III and the first episode of the King Washington storyline. The story is set in an alternate timeline in which Ratonhnhaké:ton - the one known as Connor in the main game - never joined the Assassins and George Washington crowned himself as King of America after the Revolutionary War.

In this episode, which is spent in the Wilderness, Ratonhnhaké:ton is confronted with the problems this King brings to himself and his people. He learns two new powerful abilities which enable him to call upon the powers of the wild: he can turn himself invisible and summon wolves for assistance (the mechanics are similar to the Assassin recruits of the main game).

217334.overview:
Assassin's Creed III: The Tyranny of King Washington - The Betrayal is a DLC (download content) for Assassin's Creed III and the second episode of the King Washington storyline. The story is set in an alternate timeline in which Ratonhnhaké:ton - the one known as Connor in the main game - never joined the Assassins and George Washington crowned himself as King of America after the Revolutionary War.

After the end of the first episode, Ratonhnhaké:ton finds himself as prisoner in Boston. He needs to escape and work together with the local rebels. During the course of this episode, he also receives the ability to fly.

217335.overview: The Tyranny of King Washington - Part 3: The Redemption is a downloadable content (DLC) for Assassin's Creed III. Ratonhnhaké:ton’s journey concludes in the third and final episode. Arriving in New York, Ratonhnhaké:ton will call upon all of the abilities tied to his native heritage in order to break into the monarch fortress and put an end to the tyranny of King Washington.

295683.overview:
Blazing Souls is a tactical role-playing game developed by Idea Factory and released for the PlayStation 2 in 2006. It was ported to the Xbox 360 in 2007 as Absolute: Blazing Infinity.

Set nearly two decades following the end of the Seven Years' War chronicled in Spectral Souls II's True Ending (modified Rozess Army route) the story follows the somewhat random misadventures of a freelance Contractor named Zelos and crew, who by various circumstances, is at the center of a conflict involving Elemental Cores which both beings called Human Genomes and a group known as the Original Saints are also searching for as these Elemental Cores are both the key to healing the war ravaged world of Neverland and the trigger for enthroning the intended successors of the current humanity, the Human Genome as the new dominant race. Along the way various subplots involving the cast flesh out this "war behind the scenes".

295698.overview:
Travel the five worlds, follow the three generations of heroes who protected the land of Agarest.

The world is made up of five continents, each of them has a large pillar that connects the land with the heavens, the grandness of these pillars inspires awe amongst the people in Agarest.

After the great war, the knight Leonhart is disillusioned, for the sake of something he treasured beyond everything else, he sacrificed himself, his future along with the woman he loves, together, the two became the pillar which supported the world.

However, the chaos does not end there, follow his descendants' adventures as they battle for all that they hold important.

420227.overview:
Akane the Kunoichi is an 2D side-scrolling platformer where the player controls the ninja Akane. She is secretly in love with her samurai master Goro. One day he is kidnapped by Hiromi and her ninja minions. You need to rescue him by completing fifteen levels and defeating five bosses.

Akane can move around and jump. She can also cling to walls and use that position to wall jump. She attacks enemies by throwing a knife with an endless supply. By default a single one is thrown, but through power-ups the weapon can be upgraded, to throw three or five at once, also in a diagonal direction. When hit, a heart is lost and the weapon is downgraded. By collecting scrolls she can use three different ninjitsu techniques that provide a powerful attack. Levels have a time limit and time can be extended by locating hourglass items. Enemies include ninjas, huge creatures and animals such as dogs. She has four hearts that act as lives and when they are gone the entire level needs to be restarted. Optionally three charming lost kimonos can be found in each level. Levels are grouped by three and each group has a different theme with a boss at the end.

420264.overview:
Crash Time II (Alarm für Cobra 11: Burning Wheels in Germany) is a action game based on the German TV series Alarm für Cobra 11. The player takes the roles of the main characters Semir Gerkhan and Ben Jäger which are members of the freeway police. During the game they solve 32 missions, e.g. infiltrating an illegal racing club or rescuing hostages. Some of these missions are tied together but basically they are just episodes and tell no overall story. The cutscenes consist of camera shots around buildings and cars and voice acting from the original actors.

For the first time in the series it features a freely explorable town divided into two parts (city and freeway) but nonetheless the most time is spent doing one mission after another. The only thing accomplished by exploring the town are collectable car parts which improve the standard car. New missions are started when receiving radio calls by colleagues or sometimes by driving to a certain point on the map. During the game the player never leaves his car, typical goals are to stop another car (by thwarting it, shoving it a few times or crashing it), reaching a goal respectively driving through checkpoints in a limited time or beating regular races against time or other vehicles. Mostly he also has to limit the damage he does to his and other cars. Since the game is based on an action series there is usually no problem when crashing a few times, the player only has to watch that he doesn't lose his wheels because this influences the handling of the car.

Most missions are divided into secondary missions which are solved linearly. For example in one missions the player firstly has to reach a goal without causing too much damage, then tailing a truck, overtaking the truck, crashing an enemy and driving back to headquarters. The player can repeat a secondary mission as often as he wishes and also quit altogether. Later he can access this secondary mission (and already solved cases) through a case list in the main menu without having to start the free driving mode.

When starting a new mission the player can choose between three difficulty levels. Every time the players beats a mission he unlocks new starting positions on the map, new cars and new missions. Because some missions require a certain car to start suitable cars are marked with a flag besides them. There is also a mode where the player can race against other cars while choosing certain parameters, e.g. car, number of rounds or the course. These courses and cars also have to be unlocked by beating missions. The same goes for the multiplayer.

421115.overview:
This release contains:

    ArcaniA: Gothic 4
    ArcaniA: Fall of Setarrif

Both releases are slip-streamed as a single title. For the PS3 and PS4 this is the first release of the game. For the Xbox 360, the original game ArcaniA: Gothic 4 was already available for the platform, but ArcaniA: Fall of Setarrif was not previously available.

425808.overview: As one of the most elite pilots you've been invited to test a technologically advanced jet prototype with self-healing capabilities. Try to kill as many enemy drones as possible in this fast-paced air fight simulation. Show them what you've got!

449005.overview: Join Mr. Foxworthy's class and play the Are You Smarter Than A 5th Grader trivia game. Every question is based on grade school curriculum and the answers are elementary. Step up to the podium and put your smarts and memory on the line - includes over 6,000 grade school questions. Smarty Pants or Smart Alec? Choose your partner from five brainy 5th graders and test your skills at 23 subjects. More Fun for the Whole Family - Bring home the virtual $1 million prize in Homeroom Mode, take on up to 4 players in Academic Academy Mode, go head-to-head in Flashcards Mode to see who is the quickest and identify the misspelled words in Spelling Bee Mode. What would school be without Gold Stars? Earn gold stars as you work your way to the Million Dollar Question. On A Roll? Answer all the questions correctly to put your name on top of the Honor Roll!

449013.overview: AirMech Arena is a highly competitive fast-paced real-time strategy game, where players team up AirMechs to amass unrelenting combat forces and destroy the enemy team’s fortress. In the future, the last survivors of the Great War continue their fight with the ultimate war machine: the AirMech. Created using lost technology, Pilots have found, salvaged, or stolen AirMechs that they use to protect the weak, or to pillage. Which side do you fight for?

460747.overview:
AquaZone: Life Simulator is a simple simulation game where players build a fish tank, fill it with fish and then having to care for the fish.

The game becomes gradually more difficult when more types of fish get added, which all require different care. New and better aquariums are unlocked by progressing through the game and successfully caring for fish. If the player cares successfully for the fish, they might lay eggs. This unlocks new objects that can be placed in the aquariums.

The player can unlock and choose from 22 different species of fish. 18 extra fish were available through separate dlc's, able to be bought with Microsoft Points.

464113.overview:
Assassin's Creed: Heritage Collection is a compilation consisting of the main games in the Assassin's Creed series, similar to the previous Anthology bundle released in 2012; the Heritage Collection includes Assassin's Creed, Assassin's Creed II, Assassin's Creed: Brotherhood, Assassin's Creed: Revelations and Assassin's Creed III.

Unlike the Anthology bundle, the Heritage Collection includes no special packaging, extras or DLC for any of the games, and is sold at a much cheaper price.

464115.overview:
Experience the series that continues to redefine the action-adventure genre in one compelling compilation. Offering the latest games from this award-winning franchise, Assassin's Creed® The Americas Collection, provides three exciting adventures all taking place during the dangerous and thrilling years of America's beginnings. Critically-acclaimed for riveting singe-player story-telling, immersive environments and multiplayer modes, enjoy this action-packed collection of Assassin's Creed III, Assassin's Creed Liberation HD and Assassin's Creed IV Black Flag, that has achieved numerous accolades including Game of the Year.

Assassin's Creed III: The American Colonies, 1775. You are Connor, warrior son of a Native American mother and British father. As the colonies draw closer to revolution, you will dedicate your life to the freedom of your clan, becoming the spark that ignites the revolution into a full blaze. Your crusade will lead you through blood-soaked battlefields and crowded city streets, to the perilous wilderness and stormy seas. You will not only witness history…you will make it.

Assassin's Creed Liberation HD: Assassin's Creed®Liberation HD: The year is 1765. As the events leading up to the American Revolution heat up in the north, Spanish forces plan to take control of Louisiana in the south – but they have yet to reckon with Aveline, a deadly Assassin who will use every weapon and ability in her arsenal on her quest for freedom.

Assassin's Creed Black Flag: The year is 1715. Pirates rule the Caribbean and have established their own lawless Republic where corruption, greediness and cruelty are commonplace. Among these outlaws is a brash young captain named Edward Kenway. His fight for glory has earned him the respect of legends like Blackbeard, but also drawn him into the ancient war between Assassins and Templars, a war that may destroy everything the pirates have built. Welcome to the Golden Age of Piracy.

464906.overview: It's Safari time! Take you Avatar out into the wild and take on the world.

466886.overview:
Aah Little Atlantis is a puzzle strategy game where the goal is to sink Atlantis while showing pity on its inhabitants. The player needs to rescue as many Atlanteans as possible from the sinking kingdom while at the same being part of the destruction.

Each island will stay above water for a specific number of turns, and it is up to the player to save as many Atlanteans as possible by guiding them to high ground with the divine tools at his/her disposal. These are:

Floods - By placing these in close proximity to an Atlantean, he will flee one square in the opposite direction.
Meteors - These are the highest ground available, and they need to be placed in such a way that the Atlanteans stand on them when the island finally sinks.
Trees - If an Atlantean stands on a square with a tree the same round as the ground below sinks, it turns into a raft and automatically saves the person on it.
Boats - They move around the map and can save up to 4 Atlanteans at the same time.
There is a water level meter on one side of the screen which indicates when a specific type of land will vanish beneath the waves. Any Atlanteans standing on that specific land the round it sinks, will drown.

In each stage there is a set score they player has to reach to get medals and finish the stage. The different types of Atlanteans are worth different points, so sometimes the "lesser" inhabitants have to be sacrificed in order to save, for example, a king.

There are 15 islands to sink, all with varying conditions and difficulty.

The game was originally developed for the 48 Hour Games Dev Competition, but was later fixed up and polished and released for the Xbox 360. One month later the Flash version was done and uploaded to Aah Games' site.

466887.overview:
Aaron's Ping-Pong is a indie game version of Pong, with virtually identical gameplay. The game area is entirely black, and has two paddles on the left and right, with a ball going between the two and it is up to the player to prevent the ball from getting past his paddle whilst directing it past the AI controlled paddle on the opposite side.

A two player mode is also supported to allow a second player to take control of the opposing paddle for a head to head game on the same Xbox 360.

466888.overview: AardBloxX is a 3D puzzle game designed to exercise your mind. Blocks are sent at you which must be fit into flat planes at an increasing pace. You will have a blast playing this game, and it will help keep you mentally sharp and improve your spatial awareness! With two modes for both new and advanced players, it allows you to tweak gameplay to your liking for the best puzzle experience.

466893.overview: Run your way out of a treacherous volcano maze in this arcade style adventure! Challenging and rewarding gameplay awaits those with the skills to master this incredible game!

466894.overview:
In the future, football is played by advanced robots using a plasma football that gradually get hooter over the course of a game and will eventually explode. The aim of the game, to score as many goals as possible is unchanged, but instead of there being eleven players on the pitch, there are only four, two on each team, one goalkeeper and one outfield player. It is up to the player to guide one of these futuristic teams to the 'AirPlay Tournament' using the players choice of 14 robotic players.

For multiplayer games, there is support for local 2 player head to head games on a single Xbox 360 with a choice of seven arenas to choose from.

466896.overview:
Ahh Halloween pie!

Originally released on Xbox Live Indie Games on the Xbox 360 in December 2012

In this short but sweet 2D sideways scrolling platform game can you collect all of the pumpkins for the witch?

A short sideways scrolling platform game with a Halloween flavour!

Unique ingeniousfun art style

Random elements so game is different every time you play.

466897.overview: Want to be hailed the master of all media? Why not take the greatest trivia challenge ever! This isn’t exclusively for film buffs, couch potatoes, bookworms and cartoon freaks, but for everyone. Refresh your memory and get asked who played who, who said what and who did what. Show off what you got in this exciting game that will make you and your friends scream “Aah! Who’s that Character?!?”

466898.overview: Aah Impossible Rescue tasks the player with guiding three kittens who are stranded in a river across twelve levels to safety, whilst controlling all three at the same time. As the three kittens go downstream, the player must use the A, X and Y keys, which correspond to one of the kittens, to move them up and down in their respective streams. If any of the three kittens hit an obstacle however, all three of them are returned to the last checkpoint.

466899.overview: Aagh! is a two dimensional side-scrolling racer that tasks the player with guiding a small metallic ball through a narrow black corridor that sharply shifts direction at various gradients. The player has to last as long as possible without crashing into the various coloured walls of each level.

466909.overview:
Abaddon is a tower defence game set in space that gives the player control of the capital ship Abaddon, which is severely damaged, and in need of new and improved weaponry before it is over run. To provide assistance, Abaddon has a small fighter circling around her to provide support. The game will pit the player up against waves of enemy ships that range from small, lightly armed fighters to other big, heavily armed capital ships. During the course of the game, the player will be able to pick up ship and weapon upgrades for both the Abaddon and her support fighter that include both offensive and defensive upgrades. After successfully completing each mission, the player will awarded with power orbs that can be used to further modify and optimize the Abaddon and her fighter escort.

Abaddon also includes co operative support for two person offline or eight person via Xbox Live.

466928.overview:
The sequel to the Xbox Live Indie game Abaddon, Abaddon: Retribution puts the player in the role of Tara Cole, a fighter pilot who has been assigned to pilot the support fighter of the spaceship Abaddon from the first game.

The gameplay is largely the same unaltered tower defence gameplay from the first game, in which the player, as the previously mentioned Tara Cole, must engage enemy fighters in order to help protect the Abaddon, who's weapons are damaged beyond repair and must be replaced by various weapon systems that can be brought by using Green Matter, which is obtained by defeating enemies. This Green Matter can also be used to repair the Abaddon's weapons. The more it its Repaired and upgraded, new weapons will become avaliable for use on the Abaddon.

Abaddon: Retribution also features the same co-op mode, as featured in the first game, as well as support for competitive play for eight people on four Xbox 360 consoles.

466930.overview: Aban Hawkins & the 1000 Spikes is a self-described "hardest extremest craziest platform action puzzle adventure", which is a surprisingly accurate description. Controlling the Indiana Jones-esque (or perhaps Spelunky-ish) explorer Aban Hawkins, the player must navigate trap-filled labyrinths to reach the key hidden within, which can be used to open the door to the next stage. The game prides itself on its difficulty, and each stage contains an almost absurd amount of traps. The game gives Aban 1000 lives, and he's going to need every last one of them.

466931.overview:
ABC Fun is an educational game which is meant to teach young children ABC in a fun and interactive way.

The player controls his/her avatar and walks along the alphabet (displayed as kid's blocks). Every time the player stops, the letter is read out loud and an example of an item or animal is displayed (such as A is for Ant). The avatar can also use special effects such as a burst of stars or fire and flames on the blocks to make them spin and more. The avatar animates randomly between all sorts of movement types, such as swimming, laughing and running, all to stimulate the young participants.

466934.overview: As a UFO pilot in training, you have been tasked with the overwhelming mission of invading Earth, terrorizing the locals, and returning home in one piece. Use your tractor beam to abduct helpless Earthlings and defeat aggressive foes. It will take all your skills, wits, and intellect to prove your alien worth and triumph over humanity.

466935.overview: As a UFO pilot in training, you have been tasked with the overwhelming mission of invading Earth, terrorizing the locals, and returning home in one piece. Use your tractor beam to abduct helpless Earthlings and defeat aggressive foes. It will take all your skills, wits, and intellect to prove your alien worth and triumph over humanity.

466936.overview: 'Small Time Records' is in BIG TIME trouble! Can you stop Mr. Sleez? 'About to BLOW UP' is a hilariously insane hip-hop cartoon adventure jam-packed with crazy characters and mind melting puzzles! Classic point and click action! Hand drawn 2D animation! Huge cast of zany cartoon characters! Old school Hip Hop soundtrack! Laugh out loud dialog and slap stick humor!

466937.overview: Join the Abronium cyber world for a hot thrilling tournament competition. Gather friends/family and build your own cool tournament using 35 different maps from 10 different game modes (EG: Race, CTF, Soccer, Chase & Fetch). With up to 16 players in a local game you’ll have the perfect party booster. Play one-to-one or gather up in teams to see who will score the most or get knocked out.

466938.overview: Give freedom to Kaalamarii Islands. Defeat the oppressive army.

466939.overview: The gameplay of Absorb revolves around a blob that has to change colour in order to destroy enemies and absorb them in order to make the player's blob stronger. At the end of each level there is a boss battle. The absorbing process is based on four colours (blue absorbs yellow, green absorbs blue, red absorbs green, and yellow absorbs red).

466940.overview: Academy Trivia is a trivia game with more than 4,000 questions that cover eight subjects. It also has a more challenging Academy Mode. The gameplay starts with a 3D wheel being spun that has all the categories on them to decide the topic for the questions. Players then compete against one another to see who can answer the most questions accurately. The game supports up to four players locally and there are also bonus rounds.

466941.overview: A Two player tower defense. The zombies are smart targeting the closest, most populated villages first. Keep the zombies away or they will eat the the villages and grow in numbers, kill them to continue on. Play with a friend =). infinite mode. 30 something levels. Can you protect them all?

466942.overview: Abstacked is a Tetris variant where the player needs to clear stars. Pieces drop down in pairs, can be rotated, and fill up columns. A star is cleared when it ends up in-between two identical shapes. When a game starts, the stars are already present. If the player fails to clear enough star pieces before they reach the top of the playing field, the game is over. There are two game modes (Story and Infinity) and five difficulty levels.

466943.overview: The gems from the kingdom of the Round Happy Faces people have been stolen by their enemies. They're now scattered in the lands of the Death's Heads tribe, and guarded 24/7. Since explosives are the only weapon that can be used against the Death's Heads, you've been chosen to go to hostile territory and get as many gems back as possible, for your Round Happy Face's nickname is Ace of Dynamites.

466944.overview: The award winning multiplayer battle arena game Abzolium is finally coming to the Xbox 360! Fight with up to 4 players in an action-packed arena where the environment is more than just a dormant background. Create your own ability build that suits you or your team so you'll come out victorious in the upcoming rounds where kill-count is all that matters.

466945.overview:
Ace Gals Tennis is a tennis game comparable to Wii Sports Tennis. The player controls their avatar, who will automatically run towards the ball, but must correctly time the swing of the racket in order to hit the ball. When hitting or serving, the player can also control the general direction of the ball. Poor timing will result in a low-power hit that may go out-of-bounds, while flawless timing will result in "amazing" shots that will go where they're supposed to with good power. "Amazing" shots can be chained together, allowing for more powerful shots.

The player's stats are dictated by the "trainer" they choose. There are six trainers to choose (with two more unlockable), all of them young women. The game offers several difficulty modes and court types, and there are both exhibition and tournament matches available. There are also a number of "trophies" that are unlocked when certain in-game criteria are met, much like the achievements found in other games.

466946.overview: Aliens, Humans, and Robots collide! Play one of the pre-loaded game maps, or create your own mayhem using the Level Editor. Choose your faction and complete wave-by-wave of increasingly difficult enemy personnel. Manage your personnel by making the most out of points received by purchasing ammo, upgrades, special abilities, and vehicles. Make use of cover and towers to win the War of Absolution.

466947.overview:
Action Arcade Wrestling is as the title suggests a arcade style wrestling game that allows the player to customize his wrestler by adjusting the size, outfit and hair, with the colour of the outfits and hair being adjustable. Players can also assign various moves to their wrestler.

To fight bouts, the player can choose from one out of a total of ten arenas, all of which are also customisable by the player. The game modes on offer include Tag Team, Rumble, Championship and Tag Championship.

Action Arcade Wrestling also supports multiplayer for up to four people on a single console for one on one bouts, or tag team games.

466948.overview: Acid Rain puts the player in the role of a hiker hiking near a volcano coincidentally just as it explodes, causing acid rain to start falling in the surrounding area. It is now up to the player to locate the twenty survivors of the eruption by using binoculars and rescuing them whilst diving in and out of cover in order to avoid the acid rain as well as other hazards such as volcanic boulders and lava. The player will also encounter wild animals that will attempt to hinder progress, but can be warded off by using the characters flashlight.

466949.overview: Mine, trade, and fight your way to riches in this open-ended space adventure!

466950.overview: Acid Rain Heroes is the same game as the XBLA Indie game Acid Rain This version of the game adds a new multiplayer mode with 6 co-op missions.

466951.overview: The sequel to the best-selling XBLI game, AAW2 is a 2.5D retro arcade game. Hundreds of moves, multiple match types, create wrestlers & arenas, up to 10 wrestlers in the ring at once, classic control scheme and so much more.

466952.overview: Ace on Steroids sets you in the seat of Ace, a young pilot in charge of protecting Earth from incoming asteroids. While fully playable, the goal of Ace on Steroids is to serve as a purpose to learn how to make games using Microsoft XNA, the SynapseGaming SunBurn engine and the Indiefreaks Game Framework. Visit http://indiefreaks.com to learn more.

466953.overview:
Aceball is a pong variant that puts the player in control of a paddle on one side of the screen, and a computer controlled paddle on the other side of the screen with a small ball bouncing between them, and it is up to the player to prevent the ball from getting past his paddle whilst trying to get it past the players opponent. At various points throughout the game, the player will have multiple balls to contend with, but will also have shaped paddles to help get balls past the opposing paddle.

Aceball also features local multiplayer support for competitive as well as co operative games.

466969.overview: Acupwnture is a puzzle based board game similar to Tetris based on the movements of the Wu Xing in which the player has to form groups of blocks based on the elements to create bombs that release Qi energy, which in turn the player earns points for collecting. They need to earn a certain amount of points from the elements to progress through each of the games 50 levels.

466977.overview: Command and protect a loyal and blindly obedient army of ants. With a variety of special ability upgrades, you must dig, fly, shoot and explode your way to victory as you attempt to rescue the queen ant who has been kidnapped by the evil worm and bird alliance. An addicting game of action and strategy for all ages!

466978.overview: What happens when you take lemmings, add some worms, throw in some birds (that are angry), then pit them against an army of ants? you get Adamant Ants! Excavate, climb, fly and explode your way to rescue the ant queen from the diabolical bird and worm army in PART 2 of the series! With hours of fun and stimulating gameplay, fully destructible terrain, and loads of ant ability upgrades!

466980.overview:
There once was a notorious gambler named Johnny Five Aces, who hid a treasure somewhere. There is a map to this treasure, but it has been split into six pieces, and only one who has all six pieces can find the treasure. Enter the Adventurer Pets, four anthropomorphic pets who all want the treasure for themselves, and will do whatever they can to collect all the pieces of the map.

Adventurer Pets is a multiplayer battle platform game. Up to four players battle on each stage, using items like bombs and shields to kill opponents or protect themselves, with the goal of having the most treasure at the end of the game. There is also a single-player adventure mode where the player must collect the treasure on each stage with a limited number of lives, and a time-attack mode where the player has infinite lives but dying will incur a time penalty.

466981.overview: Explore the world of Aeski, try to escape a locked room or be accepted to the School for Gifted Demons in Adventures in Text, three short multiple choice text adventures. Play with friends by co-operating and agreeing your answers. Fail to agree and the game decides your path! Also includes three quizzes.

466982.overview:
Adventures of Captain Becky is a puzzle platform game starring the titular female pirate captain. The goal of each stage is to reach the goal as quickly as possible, collecting as much gold as possible, and without dying. Becky can double-jump as well as attack with a mace, which will destroy many but not all hazards and enemies. One hit will kill her, though she can collect a special pink outfit that gives her an extra hit.

There are four difficulties with eight stages each, along with a tutorial. There is also a "gallery mode" where the player can watch Becky dance around in any of the unlocked outfits, as well as an edit mode which provides numerous options for modifying Becky's physique to the player's liking.

466983.overview: Adventures Of Sid is a 2D side scrolling platformer that puts the player in the role of Sid the tomato. Armed with a flamethrower and some TNT, the player must guide Sid through 16 levels in search of treasure. However, hindering Sid are obstacles as well as crazed wildlife that keep the player from his goal. As well as uncovering treasure, fresh ammo for the flamethrower and new explosives will need to be found sooner or later.

466984.overview: Enjoy a classic platform game! Through 8 worlds of the prehistoric, battle against dinosaurs and take on dangerous roads with our friend Rocaman.

466985.overview:
Adrift is a modern day pirate game that puts the player in the role of a nameless Somali pirate operating in the Gulf of Aden who is aiming to move up the pirate ranks by looting and pillaging other ships.

The player controls the ship of said nameless pirate and must navigate through the Gulf of Aden looking for ships to raid. To aid this, the players boat is armed with weaponry to take on other ships. Also at the players use is several smaller boats to board and capture ships. It is also possible to form alliances with other pirates to make it easier to capture loot.

There is also a co-op mode available for up to four players for offline games.

466986.overview: Adventures Of Sid XMAS Special is a Christmas themed remake of the XBLA Indie game Adventures Of Sid. As with the original game, the player (once again in the role of Sid the Tomato) must blast through obstacles and wildlife using Sid's trusty flamethrower in search of treasure. As this is Christmas themed, obstacles come in the form of Christmas related items such as Christmas crackers and Reindeer's.

466987.overview: Add some light to your life by letting your screen fill the room with beautiful colors of your choice! This special light app has a variety of modes suitable for different occasions. E.G: Heart - For romantic dinners. Stroboscope-For crazy parties. Clock-As a nice digital/analog clock. Flowers-As color changing art. It also has classic RGB etc.. Customize the modes by using special meters.

466988.overview:
The Adhara War is a turn-based strategy game with action combat. It is set in the Clamshell Expanse where the Neoterrans, the descendants of humanity, settled. After finding old ruins on the planet Adhara, they managed to build space gates - which caused them to meet the Hegemony, an alliance of multiple alien races. The Hegemony claims ownership over Adhara which eventually leads to a declaration of war. Now the fate of Adhara lies in the hands of the Guards, basically an AI network taking command over the war effort, who fight against the Hegemony.

On the strategy map (a 5x7 grid), both factions move in turns. The overall goal is wiping out the different faction completely. To do so, the player requires resources which are earned by assimilate planets which produce a certain number of resources each turn. Those are not only used to build additional ships in the homebase, but also platforms on any owned grid: jammers (disable special abilities of enemy vessels during combat) and shipyards (used to repair and build ships). Additionally refineries double the resource production of a planet. Each ship can move a certain number of grids each turn and capturing a planet only means to occupy the grid for one turn.

When two hostile ships meet, action combat begins. The goal is is to eliminate the opposing ship by shooting the primary/secondary weapons as well as using abilities. The equipment changes from ship to ship, for example the destroyer has a standard energy weapon, a secondary seeker missile and a shield which absorbs energy damage. To move a ship forward, the player needs to hold one gamepad stick in the same direction as the ship faces; rotating the stick (also available during movement) also rotates the ship. Only a few Hegemony ships can aim independently from the movement direction with the second stick. In this phase it also becomes important on which grid combat takes place: anomalies have properties (e.g. less energy damage) which affect both ships.

Besides the ship abilities, there are also other differences between the two factions. Most importantly, the Hegemony has a space gate as main base and random reinforcements come through it. It can only be destroyed by constructing and using a special ship (basically a bomb). The skirmish game mode allows to set up an action match without the strategy part.

466989.overview:
Ellica is a Demonic Magic Studies student at one of the most prestigious schools in the realm, Aeternum Academy. But her schoolwork has to take a back seat one day when she discovers her best friend Macy is missing!
Help Ellica brave the crazed groundskeeper, an overzealous hall monitor and waves upon waves of wayward flying cats in the adventure of a lifetime… or maybe just the adventure of this week.

466992.overview: Long range communications aboard the 'Century Research Station' have abruptly stopped shortly after a distress signal was sent out. With military forces spread far and few in-between, a freelance vessel has been contracted to investigate and report on the problem. Little do the intrepid travelers know, something dire lurks in the dark of Century Station...

466993.overview: Agent MOO: Maximum Overdeath is a 2D deathmatch game featuring weapons such as rockets, guns, and the trusty sack of oranges. If that doesn't suit your fancy, climb in a car to get some vehicular homicide kills! Features original soundtrack by I KILL PXLS.

466994.overview:
Aesop's Garden is a puzzle game in which the player must guide Aesop round his garden moving blocks and activating switches whilst avoiding traps.

After his prize winning garden is destroyed by his rival Alistair August in an attempt to keep him from winning another gardening competition, Aesop must now re-build his garden in time for a big gardening competition. The player takes control of Aesop and must go through his garden digging up every weed through each level.

466996.overview:
Ahoy Pirates is a naval strategy party game that places the player in control of a pirate ship in search of treasure. Players must navigate their ship around the game field collecting as much treasure as they can find within the time limit.

Ahoy Pirates can also be played between four different players on a single Xbox 360 console for multiplayer games.

466997.overview:
Aimeroids is a space based shooter game similar in concept to the game Asteroids. Gameplay involves the players spaceship flying around an asteroid field blowing up asteroids without getting hit around the head by one. The player will also have passing alien ships to contend with by blowing them up as well.

There are two game modes available, the first is called "Retro", and is the basic shot the rock version with no strings attached. The second is called "Powerplay", which is largely the same as Retro, only now the player has access to power ups that can aid them such as shield upgrades and improvements to the players weapons.

466998.overview: Take to the skies over North Africa in a P-47 Thunderbolt to defend against the German Luftwaffe. Attempt to break past their fighters and destroy their base while your squadron provides cover. Your armament includes wing mounted .50 cal machine guns and the option to equip a variety of rockets and heavy bombs.

466999.overview:
Air Legends is a WWII aerial dogfighting game. The player takes control of one of ten planes available and take on planes in a top down perspective and take on multiple enemies.

Air Legends also supports two player offline play, both has head to head and co operative multiplayer support.

467002.overview:
Air Forte is an educational flight game that tasks the player with answering questions based on mathematics, geography and vocabulary by using the players plane to shoot them. Points are awarded based on how well the player does.

Up to four players can engage in competitive play on a single console.

467014.overview: Aircraft RC is a simulator of radio-controlled airplane models.Aircrafts are equipped with retractable landing gear. The game display shows the throttle, aircraft speed, and radio control signal. There are three aircraft available.

467015.overview: Airport Anarchy is a game where you must complete flights while managing the flow of aircraft to and from the airport. In arcade mode you earn more points the quicker you deal with aircraft, while Endless mode won't finish until there's a crash!

467021.overview: Experience air to air combat against AI controlled enemies, only to get jumped by human players at any moment. Manage your power supply mid battle... shields? lasers? engines? Upgrade your ship and show off your moves to friends. Supports up to 8 players at once. Music by Bensound.com

467027.overview:
Akujin is a top down space shooter similar to the XBLA game Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved, in which the player is given control of a fighter and must fight of waves of enemies. The weapons of the players fighter craft are based on various properties such as gravity and electricity. These are only effective against certain enemies.

Also featured in Akujin is a two player offline co operative mode.

467030.overview: Airport Anarchy - The Lost Runways is a game where you must complete flights while managing the flow of aircraft to and from the airport. In arcade mode you earn more points the quicker you deal with aircraft, while Endless mode won't finish until there's a crash!

467031.overview: Play Ajare & Watch, the most powerful and expensive LCD Game on the market... $50,000. Multi Screen x10, RPG and ninjas.

467033.overview: Akimbo Paddles! is a dual wield paddle game in which the player must either keep a series of balls afloat using two paddles, or attempt to pair up other pairs of balls, often within a time limit. The paddles are controlled by the two analog control sticks. There are 24 levels of gameplay in total, with the difficulty going up from level to level.

467034.overview: Alawishus Pixel is a retro-style puzzle platform game. A nameless young man in a hoodie has wandered into a cave, and the only way out is forward. The only way out of each room is to push a block onto a yellow switch, which will open a door leading to the next room. Many rooms contain hazards like ogres, bats, and lava, and one touch will kill the hero. Many rooms also contain signs left by a previous traveler, offering hints, instructions, and sometimes insane rambling. The player has infinite lives, and can reset the stage if it becomes unsolvable. The game features 40 puzzles to solve, and allows the player to return to any previously-visited stage through the options menu.

467036.overview: You are Agent Alan Gingerspicy/Alana Gingerspicy in search of aliens in Antarctica. Explore the alien bases and eliminate aliens from the Earth. Choose either task oriented "Adventure" mode or hardcore "Wipeout" mode. Upgrade to cool weapons in this kill'em all mission.

467037.overview: Alien Hunter is a first-person shooter (FPS) in which the player's character has been abducted by aliens and the player must now escape from them. Unfortunately, since the abduction took place, the teleporter needed for the players escape has broken down and the player must go on a hunt for these parts whilst dealing with the aliens that are attempting to subdue him.

467038.overview: Alien OverKILL. Clear the space ships of alien monsters in this first person 3D alien horror shooter.

467039.overview:
Alderman is a medieval jousting game that puts the player in the role of the titular hero. With the king away from the kingdom, Count Wharfdale decides to stage a takeover of the kingdom. It is now up to the player to take on the count's minions atop of his horse and joust his way to victory.

Gameplay involves guiding your horse mounted hero across the level, taking out enemies using the trusty lance.

467040.overview:
Alien Jelly is a 3D puzzle game. It uses a mechanic of flipping the world around to solve puzzles and get your avatars to the exit point. The player controls multiple Alien Jelly characters that come in a variety of four colors, which each play a roll in some of the puzzles. The game also supports up to 4 players local co-op.

The additional puzzle mechanics include portals, pushing crates, stacking Alien Jellies to create stairways, color changing blocks that only allows a character of the same color to be on it, hologram blocks that can be turned on and off to create pathways. The game includes hazard elements such as spike pits, crushing blocks, lasers and robots that shoot lasers.

The game sports a level editor crafted for consoles. All the levels in the game were built in the same editor that ships with the game. The players can also share these levels with friends through the Xbox Live Gold service.

467041.overview:
Alien Pyramid Challenge! is a puzzle-based platformer that has the players alien character trapped in an ancient Egyptian pyramid with only a Egyptian mummy for company.

In order to escape from the pyramid, the player must rearrange limestone blocks to allow escape, but to get to them, the player must move from platform to platform by jumping and using springs to get through each level. If the player gets stuck, the sarcastic mummy will be on hand to offer advice on how to escape.

467042.overview:
Alchemist is a puzzle game similar to Bejeweled. In Alchemist, two players attempt to form rows of three or more runes of the same colour to remove them from the board and score points during a preset amount of time. Whichever player has the highest score at the end of the time limit, the player who has scored the most points is the winner. If the player forms a row of colours with a specific series of symbols on them, they will score additional points and potentially remove entire rows or columns from the playboard.

As well as being able to play against an A.I opponent, players can also play up against a human player on a local multiplayer game.

467043.overview: You can create the universe! Starting with nothing but the four basic earthly elements, you can mix and match them to create newer, more advanced ones! With over 80 unique elements, Alchemy God is sure to engross you in the world you create.

467044.overview: Water Bear Interactive LLC presents Match with Wally for the X-Box 360. Match with Wally allows the child to match Upper and Lower case letters, Star blocks with Number Blocks, Shapes and colors with their name block. The software uses randomization to reduce patterns and encourage learning. Match with Wally is part of the Alexander Learning Series.

467045.overview: Defend your planet from the incoming enemy missiles, flying saucers and asteroids using your AMS rockets and Proton blaster . With support for 1-2 players, upgradable weapons, four different stunning worlds and three difficulty settings

467046.overview: Alien Super Mega Blaster a classic retro shooter with a twist. Kill the aliens and avoid the fallout. Maximize your score with mega cascading death to the alien scrum. Over 100 hand crafted levels of blasting fun... how far can you go? All proceeds from this game will be donated to Action Duchenne.

467047.overview: The real reason Rome burned! Go back in time and fight for the empire against the Alien threat. Take up the enemies weapons and beat them back!

467048.overview: In a distant galaxy, an alien race is at war with itself. Take command of a squad of alien 'tracker' units in an attempt to thwart the plan to invade earth, in this turn-based game of strategic warfare. With multiple weapons and dozens of unit and weapon upgrades, do you have what it takes to defeat a foe with vastly superior numbers?!

467049.overview: Aliens Go Boom is a side scrolling shooter in which aliens have invaded earth. The player takes control of a fighter plane and must shoot through multiple levels taking out alien turrets in order to score as many points as possible.

467050.overview: All fives game of Dominos with all the correct rules of play.

467051.overview: Defend the homeland against the capitalist pigs, or siege the communist headquarters to prevent their victory on earth and in space. Play with up to 4 players in this fast-paced tower defense game.

467052.overview: Shmup action with different ships, customizable weapons, armors and shields. Choose your ship and upgrade your weapons as you play. Battle through 9 levels and fight intense boss battles. Adapt your ship to the levels you play or just plow through the enemies using skill alone.

467053.overview: In Allied Assault Squadron (AAS), the player experiences aerial combat as a member of an elite World War II fighter pilot team. AAS is a top down 2D aerial shooter in which the player controls one of six World War II era fighter planes, on a mission to clear the grounds and skies of enemies.

467055.overview: Alpha Morph! Collect energy from your defeated enemies to power and upgrade ship systems. Morph into powerful new forms to complete each stage.

467056.overview: Fortify your defenses and take up arms against the zombie horde. Up to 4 players can build structures, place turrets, choose from an assortment of weapons, and then watch the giblets fly.

467057.overview: All the Bad Parts is an Action Adventure that features hand to hand combat, weapons, a shifting plot line, and multiple endings. The story begins in a classroom. While trying to survive school, Corbin starts to notice that time is starting to speed up, and everything isn’t as it appears. He then has to make sense of the shifting world around him, fight waves of enemies, and make key decisions.

467058.overview: Allegory tasks the player with protecting a small cube known the 'the follower' as it travels along a series of lines of varying length and direction. Only two lines will be on screen at one time, the line the follower is on and the next line, with additional lines appearing when the follower end of the current line it is on. The player protects the follower by guiding a second, larger cube to deflect incoming missiles that are being drawn towards the follower. Points are awarded based on how many the player deflects away from the follower. The player has limited use power ups called 'Slowdowns' available for use, which slows the game play down and gives the player extra time to reach the incoming missiles.

467059.overview: Amazing 8bit Ball utilizes the processing power of your Xbox to think really hard about stuff you ask it.

467060.overview: (Almost) Total Mayhem is a 2D team-based action platformer that pits two teams against each other in an attempt to destroy the other's base, which comes in the form of medieval forts. In addition teams of knights in armor must also protect their own base from attacks. Also hindering the player's progress is that there is only a single bomb on the map. The graphics come in hand-drawn form on lined A4 paper, and look like someone has doodled them. There is a two player co-operative game mode available for use on a single Xbox 360 console for 2-player split-screen games.

467061.overview: Along Came A Spider is a 2D platformer that puts the player in control of a spider who must jump from various moving and stationary platforms that come in various colours. On white platforms the spider can be walk, climb and swing, purple ones cannot be climbed, and orange ones move other platforms along. Meanwhile the spider attempts to get home and catch the three flies that are on each level, to unlock new environments. The spider can also swing from the platforms using its webbing to catch the flies, and webbing can also be used to bridge two platforms. There are twenty levels and four special boss levels, during which the spider gains new swinging abilities. Near to some platforms are glowing white orbs that act as checkpoints and require close proximity in order to activate. At the end of each level there is a spider's web that must be entered in order to complete the level.

467062.overview: Alpha Blasters is a single-screen arena shooter similar to Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved. The player is put in control of several possible ships and must fight one of several themed enemies, including different currencies, space rocks and logos. The game includes a two-player head-to-head competitive mode.

467063.overview: In the not so distant future, Earth is ruled by a military dictatorship known as The Alliance. They have put bounties on the heads of Clint, Jin, Lynx and Lackey, four mercenaries more commonly known as Alpha Squad. The player takes control of one member of Alpha Squad using a top-down perspective. He needs to fight different enemies whilst attempting to find out who in The Alliance has put a price on their heads and why. The game features a four-player co-operative mode for two to four people on a single Xbox 360 in split-screen, or over Xbox Live.

467064.overview: Pilot a toy submarine around the ocean collecting letter and number bubbles! Over 60 levels that concentrate on the alphabet and numbers, with short levels that are meant to be easy, while the longer levels offer more of a challenge. More games in the series coming soon!

467065.overview: A fast pace gems building game with exciting attack / defense strategy. Exciting versus mode supports 1~4 players. Challenging adventure mode provides various of goals to challenge. With cooperative arcade mode, impact the high score board with your friends!

467066.overview: AAC is a falling block match three puzzle game with grid rotation added into the mix. The player has control over the falling blocks rotation and can shift the order of the colored blocks. With each rotation of the grid your combo grows.

467067.overview: Enjoy the beautiful HD graphics and music while being astonished at over 500 amazing and incredible facts. You can even send them to your friends!

467068.overview: Alpha Chimp casts the player as a chimp as he battles his way through several environments, fighting human poachers, logging company employees, space aliens and other chimps, which will ultimately lead to a fight with the alpha male of the chimp's tribe. There is also a Battle Mode included, which allows players to select a single type of enemy to fight in any of the arenas featured in the story mode.

467069.overview: A new exciting and fun way to learn the letters of the English language! Hear their sounds and enjoy the fun experience of learning!

467070.overview:
The King has been kidnapped by a fiendish demon! Only the (Amazing) Princess Sarah has the courage, and the upper body strength, to fight through the 5 demon castles to rescue him.

In Amazing Princess Sarah the player will travel through each of the five castles, completing platforming challenges before facing off against a screen-filling boss at the end of the castle. The castle interiors are broken up with checkpoints, and luckily for Sarah she has an endless supply of lives to spend as she dies repeatedly inside the castles. To defend herself Sarah has a very weak sword attack, but her main method of attack is picking up furniture or defeated enemies and hurling them at her foes. Launched enemy corpses also have additional attack properties, such as bombardiers exploding or archers flinging out a wave of arrows. Enemies defeated in quick succession are worth bonus XP, and Sarah gains HP and attack power she she levels up.

Each time the game is beaten new princesses are unlocked with different gameplay properties, like Vampire Princess Sarah or Drunk Princess Sarah.

467073.overview: Do you love water? Do you need it to live? Yaystuff quenches your thirst...to relax. When you're done putting the pedal to the metal, saving the world and blowing stuff up - load up Ambient Water. Relax and recharge. Maybe even take a nap. Come back fresh and frosty.

467074.overview: Take a journey into your minds eye! Introducing the amazing rumbling hypno disc!!! Play your own soundtracks or messages in the background and use the added rumble feature to relax your cares away.

467075.overview: Summertime may be almost over, but that doesn't mean the vacation has to be! With Ambient Travels you can travel the world from the comfort of your couch. You can visit Ireland, Hawaii, Egypt, and more! Just relax and let the ambient sounds soothe you.

467076.overview: Aminal: The Christmas Game is a 2D side-scrolling platformer that puts the player in control of a member of a fictitious band called Aminal. Players need to complete seven levels and collect as many bells as possible, before delivering them to the post box at the end of each level. The player is awarded points based on the time taken and the amount of bells obtained. If the player obtains bells fast enough, a combo bonus is provided. Whilst you are collecting bells, you will have to avoid hazards in the form of men on camels as well as snowmen with chainsaws.

467077.overview: Amoeba Generator is a game where the player takes control of an amoeba and guides it through its life cycle as it evolves in seven different stages. Each of those is a different type of game, including a shooter level, turret defense level and a level in which the player must tether genetic material in order to absorb it.

467078.overview: A neat and simple screen saver style app for your Xbox 360. Lots of color and glowiness. Features music from Deceased Superior Technician.

467079.overview: In The American Hot Dog Race the player participates in a hot dog eating contest. To eat, the player needs to bash the displayed button as fast as possible.
