This button changes over the course of the match. When the time is over, the contestant with the most points wins. Additionally to the single-player mode against nine opponents with increasing difficulty, there is also a multiplayer mode and a time trial available.

467080.overview: Amazing Wizard is a Magic Game. Make your XBOX magically answer any questions. English Only. NOTE: CHATPAD REQUIRED. (Similar to 'Peter Answers' / 'Wizard 666')

467081.overview:
Anger Management 4 is the follow-up to Anger Management 2, as there was no Anger Management 3.

Anger Management 4 is a Breakout variant. Players move a paddle left and right at the bottom of the screen and try to keep bouncing a ball to break and remove blocks from the top of the screen. The game makes the claim that the computer will mess with the player thus driving the player to anger.

The game has six difficultly level options.

467088.overview:
Ancient Trader is a sea faring trading game in which you sail your ship into unknown waters in search of trade opportunities and compete with other traders to see who can turn the best profit. During the players travels, they will also have to fight off a variety of sea monsters and search for hidden treasures for that little extra money. Fights play out in a turn-based combat screen: every opponent has openly displayed and differently colored cards with varying attack figures; one color also gives an additional attack bonus. Every turn the combatants choose one card and the one with the higher value wins.

Players can also play against up to four other people to see who can accumulate the most wealth and treasure.

467090.overview: This game will make you mad. The computer will mess with you. DEAL WITH IT!

467091.overview: Angle of Attack is similar to the XBLA game Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved, with a bit of strategy added into the mix. The player controls a triangle-shaped ship, which must collect as many 'nodes' as possible by using collection droids to obtain them. But the player will have to defend them as they collect the nodes, as they don't have any weapons. There is a co operative game mode for up to four players to join forces and collect nodes, which can be played on a single Xbox 360.

467092.overview: Blast through the procedurally generated levels as you and your partner cadet deliver an exceedingly volatile metal - Andromium - to a research lab. Requiring absolute concentration to win, this game will keep you on your toes for every second you play it.

467093.overview: Our young friend Andy has drawn his latest daydream on his notepad. He's imagining flying saucers, wild planets, moons and even black holes! Develop your spaceship piloting skills and exercise your combat skills with four weapon types as you fly around on Andy's Notepad!

467100.overview: This game makes you madder. Includes Anger Management 1

467108.overview: You have played block-matching games before, but you have never experienced the dual-stick single player or the cooperative multiplayer action of Angry Blocks. Whether on the same couch, thru System Link, or over Xbox Live, you can connect with a friend to take your block matching skills to the next level. Can anyone possibly handle all 21 colors at once? Good Luck!

467110.overview: Evade or destroy the Ninja Cats that have turned into Zombies!

467113.overview: Ant Mission - Grab the berries and put them into the colony's food hole before you get squashed by the rain! Features two modes -LCD Watch and 2D Extreme! Can you survive all 10 levels of the storm and get the highest score? Now child-friendly with new unlimited lives Toddler mode!

467114.overview: Ant General is a turn-based strategy game where you control an army of ants.

467115.overview: Meet the Giant Annunaki Princess! Run errands for her and unlock various carnival activities. A survival adventure game, surely not for the faint of heart.

467117.overview:
Barry is a man from Hawaii, who was once an ordinary young man. But one day, he was struck by a strange meteor, and now whenever he's angered, he turns into the super-strong Angry Barry, who wants to rule the earth. This usually wears off before long, but one day Barry found a fingernail in his hot dog, which made him so angry that he turned into Angry Barry permanently. Now, he's off to beat the unwashed masses and win their votes in a quest for world domination.

Angry Barry is a side-scrolling beat-'em-up political parody. Barry, the "President of Butt Kicking", must make his way through each stage, beating up conservatives, FBI agents, old ladies, and anyone else who gets in his way. Beating up enemies wins him votes, and he must collect a set amount of votes in order to complete the stage. He can punch and kick, comboing them together for additional damage, as well as jump between multiple planes, and even charge up a super-powerful "hope punch". One or two players can play simultaneously, and there are two difficulty settings.

467119.overview: In this sequel to the critically acclaimed physics based action title FishCraft, the cats have gone too far!! Experience an epic tale of deceit and revenge as the fish take the fight to the cats homeland in 42 levels of extreme destruction.

467120.overview: The Angry Fish are enjoying a hauntingly fun Halloween, when the cats decide they want something more tasty than candy or birds. After a successful trick the cats have the treat they have been after. Now its up to the fish to rescue their friends in 63 action packed levels!!

467121.overview: A selection of 3x3,4x4 and 5x5 tile sliding puzzles starring characters from Ingeniousfun games! And, these are no ordinary tiles, they are animated! Complete the puzzles quickly enough and unlock the animations for viewing in the 2D & 3D gallery/slideshow. (PRESS RB FROM GALLERY TO ACTIVATE SLIDESHOW (Not in Demo!) (you will need a 3d capable TV/monitor to enjoy side by side 3D)

467122.overview: Angry Brainless Bovines is a simple 'collect the objects' game, in which the player is tasked with collecting pints of milk from a field. It is set up as a simple maze with hedges as walls. The only problem: it has angry cows in it. They also do not take kindly to people in their field and so will attack you whenever possible. Players can use their Xbox 360 Avatar as their character within the game. There is also support for up to four players in competitive gameplay, in which they compete to see who can get the most milk. Co-op can be played on either a single 360 console, or over Xbox Live.

467123.overview: A family tragedy leads to an epic tale of intrigue and revenge. This time around the Angry Fish are leaving the sky to the birds and the fight is diving to new depths in the deep sea. Return to the battlefield with 63 uniquely puzzling levels.

467124.overview:
Angry Robot Rampage is a side-scrolling shooter about one man's battle against an endless horde of hostile robots. The aim of the game is to travel as far as possible while using a pistol and grenades to destroy any robots along the way.

There are two types of robots: robots that walk and robots that fly. The walking robots are harmless except for when they are touching the player, which will cause the player to lose health, and can easily overwhelm the player in numbers. The walking robots have a weak spot at the back of the head which allows them to be destroyed in one shot if the player is quick enough to jump behind them and shoot it before the robot turns around. Flying robots drop projectiles which harm the player. Walking robots drop pistol ammo and grenades when killed which the player can use to restock their arsenal.

The game continues indefinitely until the player dies, at which point their overall score, time survived in seconds, and distance travelled is shown.

467125.overview: In the spirit of Tetris and Hexic, Annecto offers engaging puzzle gameplay like you've never seen before. Use spells to fend off curses, complete levels, and grab the high score! Play alone or with up to 3 friends!

467126.overview: In this exciting twin-stick shooter, players have to complete mazes and defeat bosses using a variety of weapons and abilities. Play with friends and work your way through the 30 mazes of the game!

467131.overview:
God is pissed and so he decided to destroy four human cities. The player controls his hand and rains down lighting with a button press. Contrary to the rumours, god's power is not limitless: each shot drains from his overall lighting power and when all is gone, the level is over. To beat a level, at least 80% of the overall value needs to be destroyed.

By holding the button longer, god can also emit middle and strong lightning bolts (which drain more energy). This is necessary, because certain items react differently to the lightning. For example, most buildings require a strong zap to be destroyed while vehicles and elephants become out of control after a middle one. Additional items to look out for are water-holding structures (splatting water on other buildings or people makes them become conductors), transformers (give back power when destroyed) and exploding items (blast damage). On the other hand, lightning rods are god's biggest enemy because they absorb the charge. Killing the pope gives negative points.

Because of the limited available energy, this is a puzzle game: the player needs to find out the correct steps to beat the four levels.

467133.overview: Aphelion Episode 2 Wings of Omega features 5 playable character, tons of skills, quests, fast-paced dungeons, NewGame+ and a lot more! The 6+ hour story continues and Savion must contend with enemies on two fronts as you unravel who the true orchestrator is of the attack on Earth!

467134.overview: Be the best racer in the Ninja Edition of Antigrav Racing Championship. Choose any of the 8 high speed hovercrafts and rule on the 5 Ninja race tracks. ARC Ninja Edition features a top 50 online scoreboard for each track. Can you make it to the top ??!!

467135.overview: Be the best racer in the Viking Edition of Antigrav Racing Championship. Choose any of the 8 high speed hovercrafts and rule on the 5 Viking race tracks. ARC Viking Edition features a top 50 online scoreboard for each track. Can you make it to the top ??!!

467136.overview:
In Aphelion, the player takes on the role of the reckless soldier Savion Mercante, a soldier of the Ereit Peacekeeper group, who has assigned him, his friend Ashley and their commanding officer Ceda to investigate an attack on a human colony by an alien race known as the Crimsons. During this investigation, they save a senior Crimson ambassador. As a result of their heroics, they are selected for a special mission to locate and rescue the scientist Delith from the crimson on a distant planet.

Gameplay is turn based sci-fi shooter with an RPG upgrade system, allowing you to upgrade Savions stats, as well as the stats of his squad which give them new offensive and defensive abilities.

467137.overview: Alone or with friends, you must face the end of the world. Each day the game gets more difficult and you will need to plan your playtime carefully or risk losing your entire group. How many days will you survive?

467138.overview: A war where the city it depends on you...

467139.overview: Journey in 3D inside the human body and fight the alien virus using your blaster and shield.

467140.overview: Are you quick enough to stay ahead of the sizzling hot lava? Can you stay calm under the pressure as you race against the lava to get as high as you can? Explore a huge level with secret power ups and alternative paths as you try to get higher than anyone else.

467141.overview: It's time to prove that you are the best antigrav racer. Hover at super high speed in this addictive 60 FPS 3D simulation on 20 differents race tracks. Choose between 8 antigrav vehicles with their own characteristics and try to beat the best race and lap times. Master the 10 championships on 4 planets and win all the trophies. Be the first on the Online scoreboards! 3, 2, 1, GO !

467142.overview:
Arm yourself with the ability to reverse gravity in this action-packed side-scrolling adventure!

With the power to flip the force of gravity, you can run on the ceiling, leap incredible distances, and even use gravity to vanquish your enemies!

Try your skills at multiple difficulty levels and unlockable Challenges. Channel your inner speed-runner and find the fastest way through each level to beat their target times. Also features a special bonus mode for owners of Cosmos X2!

467143.overview: Search, Collect, Survive, The Zombie Apocalypse! Open world sand box zombie survival game with 1 - 16 player online PvP! Fully repairable vehicles and tents to save your loot in. You'll need to use all your survival skills to avoid or destroy the 2000 zombies on this map. Don't forget to get food, water, medical supplies, and weapons on your journey.

467146.overview: Travel the trail in Apocalyptic Path: Trail of Fears. This survival adventure game, inspired by the classic Oregon Trail, will take you on a journey across the apocalyptic wastes of the United States in search of a mysterious utopia on the East Coast of Florida. Do you have what it takes to lead your team to safe harbor in Cape Canaveral?

467147.overview: Check your phone to see where enemies are lurking as you hunt for items throughout the house. Dart through rooms and choose your hiding spots carefully. WARNING: Contains jump scares that will make your friends scream.

467150.overview: AppPack 3 is the final AppPack in the series. It has 4 apps and 4 games. Games: StarWings 3, Mini-RPG, Gravity Dash 3, and ArrowStorm II Remix. Also includes Indiemon: Earth Nation Guide Book.

467151.overview: Apple Orchard Math is an educational game which challenges the player's mathematical skills. The player can choose challenges specific to addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, as well as set the lowest and highest numbers (between 12 and 99) that they wish to be tested on. In each challenge, the player is presented with an incomplete mathematical expression (for example "_ + _ = 10") and is given a selection of numbers to use to complete the expression. Each correct answer places one apple on an apple tree in the titular orchard. Once 10 apples have been placed on the tree, the game ends and the player receives a score based on their performance.

467160.overview:
Add a little ambience to your living room with Aquarium HD! It has amazing looking scenes and a variety of different fish, each with its own unique behavior.

Aquarium HD is the most realistic looking fish tank game on the XBOX. It’s perfect for entertaining guests and is super-easy for the kids to use. Feed the fish or tap on the glass to make them dart around!

467161.overview: A fast-paced dual-stick shooter, Arbor Vitae blurs the genre by giving you command of a squadron of gung-ho nanobots. A furious horde of enemies is intent on destroying your growing tree and only the unique combination of your merciless assault and powerful A.I. command modes can stop them. Anyone can save the world; it takes a hero to save a tree.

467162.overview: Arcade of Neon is a collection of various game modes ranging from table tennis to fast paced color dodging and matching that will test your skills by throwing different mechanics at you with each game mode. Complete challenges to unlock more game modes and get the #1 highscore!

467163.overview: The galaxy is shrinking. Exploration remains as the current mode of man...but some parts of this great black void are better left unchecked... Lancer Corp. Arc Division is tasked with deep space exploration, an admirable notion, but from the depths of the abyss, a new enemy emerges...one that could doom all humanity.

467164.overview: AppPack is an assortment of 12 Apps and 4 Games.

467165.overview:
Aqua Kitty is a fast paced retro styled submarine arcade shooter with optional 2 player local Co-op.
Blast through hordes of mechanical sea monsters in your kitty sub and defend the deep sea milk mining kittens!
THE MILK MUST FLOW!

Due to a sudden shortage of milk, cats around the world are forced to seek out new sources to get their fix.
You and your team of milk mining kittens have overcome a fear of water to drill down under the ocean seabed and begin extracting vast reserves of what seems to be naturally forming full-fat milk.
Get ready for fast paced submarine action, defending the kittens from disruptive mechanical sea creatures.## Key Features

467166.overview: Submerged beneath a vast alien ocean, the cosmic-exploration vessel Orcna is gradually disintegrating... You open your eyes to find yourself surrounded by warning lights, creaking sounds, and the faintly audible sound of running water. With pressure building rapidly, you'll need to evacuate the water quickly, avoiding malfunctioning guns and exotic aliens which are hellbent on your destruction.

467169.overview:
This is ArchRobo, a top-down shooter. Featuring incredible visuals, 28 intense levels ranging from easy to incredibly challenging, with 5 large Bosses, dozens of enemies, and a plethora of creative weapons such as the Laser Sword, and Juggernaut power-up. Features 4-player co-op Survival, and 4-player Battle mode, each with randomized layouts for endless fun!

2D, retro, robot smashing fun. Influenced by Robotron 2084. If you're an oldschool gamer looking for some nostalgia, then this shoot-em-up might be the game for you!

Simple but challenging gameplay!

467170.overview: Frenetic arena shooter supporting up to 4 players. Game experience varies with music, which is loaded automatically from the user's media library. Try to break your high scores, or play in free mode to customize your own gaming experience.

467171.overview: Arctic Ball Grind is an action packed racing game featuring rock solid physics, unique controls, and split-screen multiplayer! Drawing inspiration from snowboarding, the challenge includes mastering the control of your ball's weight as you carve around corners and tackle huge airs. Grind it now!

467172.overview: Action Game/Shooter collect zen and badges upgrade stats buy 5 different weapons

467173.overview: Armor Valley combines the thrill of a fast-paced shooter with the intrigue of a Real-Time Strategy. In a futuristic world engulfed in war and terror, you have been chosen to command the forces of The Federation to maintain global peace. But for the very first time in the history of commanders, you chose to fight alongside your men on the battle frontier.

467174.overview: Can you follow directions? Press the D-Pad in the direction of the solid arrow. Follow the arrows as they lead you to the finish. The first player to finish is the winner!

467175.overview:
ArkX is a straight Breakout variant. The player controls a paddle which is confined to the bottom of the screen and can move left or right. it is used to bounce a ball towards the blocks positioned all over the playing area. The goal is to destroy all blocks by hitting them with the ball - but failing to reach it with the paddle and letting it fall down the screen causes the loss of life en energy. Sometimes destroyed blocks leave behind power-ups which can be collected for beneficial temporary effects, e.g. the ball is glued to the paddle instead of bouncing off directly or additional balls. However, there are also negative effects such as inverted controls or invisible balls. Negative power-ups are applied directly, but one positive one can be stored for later usage. There are 40 levels which also include boss battles.

Instead of points, the player earns money while playing the 40 levels (including some boss battles) which can be spent in the in-game shop. One of the available purchases is the multiplayer modes which is reminiscent of Pong: the paddles are positioned on the screen's edges and participants score by bouncing the ball behind the other players' paddles. There are three multiplayer-exclusive power-ups which negatively effect the opponents.

467176.overview: Avoid the obstacles that lie on the train cars. Jump the barrels of the right color, break the boxes and you will make more points! More barrels you will jump in sequence and multiply your score much more! Challenge your friends trying to make the highest record!

467177.overview: There's only one way to stop an adventurer - an Arrow in the Knee! Defend your castle from hordes of adventurers and other strange and powerful foes. To get past all 30 waves and defeat the boss monster, you'll need to to master your growing arsenal of tactical and magical weapons as you build your castle guard with a well aimed... Arrow in the Knee!

467179.overview:
Architektris (a portmanteau of architect and Tetris) is an arcade-style strategy game where the player must build sturdy towers to protect food from hungry bears.

At the start of each level, the player enters an "architect mode" where they must use Tetris-esque blocks to build a tower. The player is free to use as many blocks as they want in constructing the tower, but there is a limit to how many can be directly touching the ground at any one time. The tower must also contain a certain number of food items.

Once the player has constructed a valid tower, they enter a "defence mode" where the integrity of their tower is put to the test by hungry bears being catapulted from the left of the screen, trying to knock the food onto the ground. The player starts defence mode with a score based on how many blocks they used in their tower and how many are touching the ground. The score decreases with each block that is knocked onto the ground, and losing the food reduces the score to 0. The player wins the level if the score exceeds a certain threshold when defence mode ends.

467180.overview: 'Are you fast enough?' will challenge your reactions. Build one line after another to reach the ultimate height. (V1.3)

467183.overview: Experience a sexy and mysterious adventure in Ariane Odyssey !

467185.overview: Arena of Fire is a particle simulator akin to the falling sand internet phenomenon games. Arena of Fire uses the Xbox's video card to perform all the particle logic, providing an extremely fast high-definition simulation. The elements included are dirt, concrete, water, oil, fire, plant, and gunpowder.

467188.overview: Arranger!: My Avatar is a jigsaw puzzle game. The game offers 16 pictures to reassemble. The puzzles themselves are broken up into a number of square grids. The more grids a puzzle has the more difficult and time consuming the puzzle becomes. The game has additional difficulty since the individual pieces need to be rotated into the correct position.

467189.overview:
Advanced Rock Paper Scissors is based on the game of rock, paper, scissors, but it replaces the traditional hand gestures with the elements wood, water and fire, that now appear on cards.

At the beginning of each round both players are dealt cards representing each element with numbers on them. If the player wins a round, they score the points on the front of the card. The player with the most points at the end of the game wins.

Advanced Rock Paper Scissors can also be played between two human players on the same console.

467206.overview:
One day, King Kat wakes up in a strange place, after having one too many drinks the night before. He must make his way back home, and reclaim his castle! SWAP! is the second title in the Arkedo series, and is a block-matching puzzle game similar to Tetris Attack. Blocks rise from the bottom of the screen; the player can move a cursor around with the left stick, and swap the highlighted block with a neighboring block with the right stick. Line up four blocks of the same color to clear them and keep the stack from reaching the top of the screen.

In addition to the blocks, there there are also lightning blocks which will clear a large part of the screen when matched, as well as various treasure, which can be collected for lots of points by clearing blocks next to it. Higher levels introduce more colors new items, and increase the game speed. The game includes Castle mode, where King Kat tries to return home to his castle; Arcade mode, where the goal is to survive and attain a high score; and Challenge mode, where specific challenges must be completed to clear each stage.

467208.overview:
Aardvark is a ball and paddle game that gives the player control of a paddle and tasks the player with destroying a formation of blocks with a metallic ball whilst making sure it does not fall below the paddle. As blocks get taken out, some will drop power-ups such as machine guns for the player's paddle that will allow him to clear out blocks faster. These are stackable, so you can have several queued at once. The game comes with 36 levels and the high scores are stored on leaderboards.

There is also a level editor included to allow players to come up with their own customized levels. A two player co-op mode is available for a team game to help clear blocks faster. Two players can also play against each other to clear their game field the fastest.

467209.overview: Advance is a strategy board game in the classic style of Go or Pente. The objective of Advance is to score more points than your opponent by placing your pieces and capturing your enemy’s. Placing pieces creates areas of influence, fortifying your position or attacking your opponents areas of influence. Play up to 4 players with three levels of AI to play against.

467210.overview: Eat / shoot your way through endless levels of Arcade Snake action including 25 distinct maze patterns. The "trial version" of the game features the first 4 levels of play. Four game difficulty modes: Easy / Medium / Hard / Extreme.

467213.overview: This party game features 6 minigames, all of which support 1-4 players competitively or co-operatively. Work with (or against) your friends as you build your vocabulary of Spanish words! Supports drop-in and drop-out at any time. ¡Vámonos!

467214.overview:
A giant Iron Crab has appeared, and is dropping bombs all over the place. Someone needs to stop it, and a strapping young lad named Jumpboy rises to the challenge! JUMP! is the first title in the Arkedo series of retro-style indie games. It is a puzzle platform game where the player must guide Jumpboy around, collecting all of the bombs before they explode, while also collecting as much money as possible, and reaching the exit without dying.

There are numerous hazards on each stage, including crabs, snakes, bats, fire, and spikes, all of which will kill Jumpboy with a single hit. Each bomb on each stage has its own timer, and if any of them expires, then it will explode and Jumpboy dies. Some bombs are hidden inside treasure chests, as well, which will only open once Jumpboy has enough cash. There are a total of 30 stages and no continues, as well as unlockable challenge stages for clearing each stage with all of the money collected.

467217.overview:
Arcadecraft is an economic simulation in which the player takes over and manages an arcade from 1980 to 1986. The goal is obviously to earn as much money as possible; at first in order to pay off a loan, later into the own pockets.

The basic playing mechanic is simple: the player buys arcade machines, places them in the arcade and regularly (manually) empties the arcade to receive the money. The most important part in the business is to stay popular. The game ranks the arcade in various positive and negative areas - e.g. up-to-date machines, decor or layout - and determines the overall popularity from that. New machines (parodies of real games) are released regularly; these obviously bring in more money than old ones. Machines have to be repaired sometimes and the player can set the price and difficulty for each one individually. When the arcade is big enough, employees can be hired to help with the coin collecting. During the course of the game there are also special events which require strategic decisions, e.g. a vendor for expensive Japanese machines or a professional gamer which occupies a machine for a long time but brings a lot of popularity if he manages to beat the high score.

467219.overview: Help Aron in his open-world challenging adventures! Cross dark forests, labyrinthine dungeons and gloomy caves to survive! But hopefully, Aron can evolve to jump higher, get more health, and finally throw fireballs! Beware though, many traps await you. But, you won't be alone, a second playable hero will lend you a hand!

467222.overview: This game will make you think a lot!. Are you smart enough to beat it? ;) Plus 13 cool sound tracks.

467223.overview: Guide your UFO, using your limited fuel to abduct as many peeps as you can.

467224.overview:
Pixel the Cat has gotten bored, and decides to leave the house and head off for the city to meet his friends. Along the way, he'll visit many places and see all sorts of amazing sights. PIXEL! is the third title in the Arkedo series, and is a side-scrolling platformer starring the titular feline. It features a striking retro aesthetic where virtually everything is constructed of large glowing white pixels on a deep blue background.

Pixel can run and jump along platforms and on enemies, and can also zoom in to "investigate" suspicious parts of the stage. The investigation mode involves navigating an extremely-zoomed-in maze, sometimes with a time limit, in order to find items, as well as activate environmental effects like chopping down a tree or turning on a snow machine. Hazards are plentiful, but there are regular checkpoints and infinite lives. The game features six unique stages, each of which also contains three hidden "useless relics" to find.

467229.overview: Arcane Brawlers is a very simple Xbox arcade game in which each player (up to four) controls a magical wizard (mage). It is a 2D, overhead view game. The players stock magical elements, represented by the buttons' colors. A: Earth B: Fire X: Water Y: Air The goal of the game is to simply kill the other players by making their Hit Points get reduced to zero.

467231.overview: Artoon chronicles the adventures of Art as he bounces his way through a variety of visual artworks. Can you earn those elusive top rankings in this score-attack psychedelic platformer?

467232.overview: As Easy As 123 BlackJack is a fair, fast and fun new spin on the classic game of Blackjack. Place your bets on one of three hands for a chance to win. It's easy to pick up and play but difficult to master.

467233.overview: Explore a big open world in this crazy Role Playing Platformer! Play with 3 different characters, drive a car, a bike, a boat or even a spaceship, buy equipment to get new abilities, chat with a bunch of villagers, travel through more than 100 levels in various landscapes and most of all discover a definitively crazy story, with a lot of surprises!

467235.overview: Try your hand at this geography quiz game for all ages! Zoom over the surface of the Earth and test your knowledge of nearly 600 real-life locations, all while racking up points and racing to beat the clock. Perform special feats in-game that allow you to unlock up to 65 high quality wallpaper images to be used in your own custom Screen Saver.

467237.overview: AtomHex is a colourful, fast-paced shooter where you pilot your ship through a world filled with Atoms, Hexes and their enemy offspring. Collect Power-ups and chain Multipliers to attain outrageous scores. Can you survive long enough for 6 Atoms to join a Hex and go Subatomic?

467238.overview: "Out beyond the edge of the universe. Far past any celestial wilderness you could hope to imagine, lies a vast ocean of impenetrable rock...". Test your piloting skills in this addictive one button action game. With 4 different modes ranging from Classic to Double Rainbow. The odds of surviving this game are 3720 to 1. Have you got the minerals?

467239.overview: Astralis is a military science fiction shooter. Combat - purge swarms of alien terrors. Exploration - cross a vast landscape, filled with discovery. Judgment - who will you punish? Who will you forgive?

467240.overview: Explore vast alien landscapes! Zap all of the aliens! Hey, they were blocking your view.

467241.overview: AstroPuzz combines retro asteroid game action with puzzle game strategy. Fire colored warp probes at asteroids to collect them. Be careful! Only like colored warp probes can be used together to collect asteroids. Differing colored warp probes destabilize and fly off!

467242.overview: In Asphalt Jungle you have to build a solid road for a car by rotating existing road fields. Your goal is to let the car drive along the road as long as possible. (V1.6)

467243.overview:
Chill during the cool season! Walk around and answer 500 all new questions! Whip snowballs at your friends. Find presents to dress the snowman!

Get into the spirit with Ask My Avatar Winter!

467244.overview: Astral is a conquer-all strategy casual and ambient game. Enter this atmospheric journey through time and space. Trial version lets you play the first five levels.

467246.overview: Jump into the cockpit of this fast paced, twin stick, arcade, space shooter. Fly threw countless levels in three different game modes.

467248.overview: Get your war gear ready and join your friends on the battlefield in this fast-paced twin-stick military shooter. Up to 8 players online, Deathmatch & Team Deathmatch modes, and an array of characters and weapons to choose from.

467250.overview: Hop in your space ship and clean the galaxy of star dust. Fly solo or challenge a friend to a head-to-head battle!

467251.overview:
Everyone is asking!

Walk around the park and answers as many questions as you can from your Avatar friends! See how your answers stack up with others on Xbox Live!

467252.overview: Not the usual Match3 game at all: let us introduce you to a brand new, fully original gameplay and gives you an insight about Magic Gemstones! 30 levels to play with 50 different board schemes in two different modes: our original mode and the traditional one. To unlock all the Planetary Gemstones you have to finish the game in both modes: will you succeed? Gold accounts also get LIVE High Scores!

467253.overview: Astro Taxi 2 introduces the feature you could not even imagine in your wildest dreams: Multiplayer!!! Play the new duel mode and beat your friends or play the party mode with up to 8 Players and be the king of your Astro Taxi party.

467255.overview:
Do you have what it takes to put together a manufacturing line to produce the desired product? Find out by using up to 12 of the 25 different machines to create the requested product.

100 levels are included and once these are completed, you will gain access to the level editor to continue creating your own levels.

Unlock new machines as you complete more levels.

Can you figure it out?

467256.overview: the new atomic twin stick shooter for Xbox!

467257.overview: Can you master inertia to dodge and shoot rocks, pick up supplies and escape sneaky missiles in 3d? Featuring challenging levels and beautiful space sceneries, Asteroid Sharp Shooter suits both relaxed players and hardcore gamers. Play with or against up to 3 of your friends in split screen for additional fun.

467258.overview: Astral War is a card game where : * You are considered as fighter on the battlefield and have attack points. * There is no land, you get mana each turn depending on your type of player : warrior, magician or human. * There is no « summoning sickness » : once an ally is called on the battlefield it can attack.

467259.overview: Follow Sam, a gritty Nomad, who has a chance encounter with a certain Command Ship Operator. While the Operator is nowhere to be seen, Sam fights for his life to repay a debt to his expired crew. He has his work cut out for him, but with nothing to live for, Sam is on a journey for Retribution...

467260.overview: I don't have a crystal ball, but Angela does! If you are lucky she will tell you your future.

467261.overview: Astro Taxi is a 2D Flying game which takes you into the year 2061 where you are the first Astro Taxi Pilot. Bring all your passengers to their destinations and prove that travelling with an Astro Taxi is the fastest and most secure possibility to travel.

467262.overview: Astro Tempest is a fast pace arcade style game with modern enhancements such as high definition graphics and 3D elements. Use your ships advanced navigation and weapons systems to hunt down and blowup asteroids. Prevent them from destroying major cities such as New York and Tokyo. Collect ship upgrades to help fight the battle. Each level becomes progressively more difficult with new challenges!

467263.overview: Assault Ops: Warzone takes the military action of its predecessor into first-person view, adding a new urban environment, day/night lighting, and headshots! Team up with your friends and compete online for the top of the global scoreboards.

467264.overview: Tear a swatch of destruction through space in this action-packed shooter. Aim carefully with the targeting reticule as each successful shot charges the special weapons faster: each of which can turn the tide of battle as you blow your enemies to pieces.

467265.overview: The road building game is back.

467266.overview: Asteroid Capture is a multiplayer game where up to 4 players race to collect the most asteroids by any means necessary. Use your laser weapon or just bash into your opponents. You can also play alone and try to beat your own highscore.

467267.overview:
The death of a King. An epic challenge to choose a new ruler. Will the youngest of four brothers turn out to be the strongest? Will a boy become King? The answer is up to you.

Classic adventure-platformer gameplay.
Explore and encounter strange creatures - some harmless, some not.
Navigate dangerous passages and evade deadly traps.
Seek out elemental shrines and receive upgraded abilities.

467268.overview: Fight it out with 3 friends in Battle mode of this arena brawler. Sharing similarity’s with Super Smash Bros. and Towerfall Ascension, fight on sky island and looped style arenas or create your own in the arena editor. Alternatively test your skill in Ascension mode and see how high you can climb the tower. Includes Ascension, Battle, Horde and Race game modes.

467269.overview: Astralia is "A Real-time Strategy Shooter Experiment", a top down space shooter with RTS elements; in addition to your own ship you control a squad of drone fighters with multiple formations and weapons. You also get to manage a couple of capital ships that can be moved around to attack the enemy and can build other things like weapon platforms and bombs.

467270.overview: Dominate the galaxy in this unusual multiplayer twin-stick shooter. Destroy your enemies, take their clusters and navigate cosmic dangers across a wide variety of levels and game modes. Improve your skills in the co-op campaign then take the fight online to prove who is the Cluster Master!

467271.overview: Up to 6 players or robots compete to take over the game board in this easy to pick up but hard to master board game. Place and grow your atoms to lead to large chain reactions that capture the board. Save your wins and replay them at your leisure. 6 players locally or online play.

467272.overview:
The last of the dinosaurs was a strange creature. He lived under the sea, and his greatest pleasure was reading. He sat and read the classics, waiting for shipwrecks to drop literature for him, and was content. That is, until the day he got an Internet connection, and he saw how far we had fallen. Now he swears revenge on humanity for their crimes against language.

The goal of Attack of the 50ft Verbose Dinosaur is to destroy buildings by spelling words. The dinosaur has a number of letters stored in his spikes, which can be launched towards a building. Letters will connect to each other, and when they spell a word they will glow red. Hit a glowing word with a fireball, and it will explode, damaging the building; longer words with uncommon letters do more damage and award more points. Every so often, a helicopter will fly past towing a word with a letter missing; if the player hits the helicopter with the missing letter, a bonus is awarded such as extra time. The player must destroy all the buildings in each stage before the timer runs out.

467273.overview: This is an amazing action platform game where you must help the planet Earth of the attack of the evils androids. With 25 levels full of action and fun, where you need to fight with different hard opponents and save as many people as you can. This is an intensive physics game where you can smash walls, break floors, use elevators and other levels

467274.overview: The latest zombie survival shooter from Krooked Gaming. In single player or up to 4 player co-op, Attack of the Zombie Horde is pure shoot em up action offering Campaign & Survival modes. Unlock new weapons as you progressively battle with a relentless onslaught of undead zombies. The mission: Your elite military unit is left stranded in a remote, frozen wasteland and it’s kill or be killed!

467275.overview: A gritty zombie shooter focused on refined game mechanics. Xbox LIVE and local multiplayer co-op zombie killing action. Use turrets, nukes, mini-guns and chainsaws to go on a 4 player coop rampage killing zombies and anything else that moves. A deep weapon loadout and perk system to allow you to choose how you play, from cluster mines, to air strikes to flame throwers and everything in between.

467276.overview: In Atomic Blast up to 16 players take turns to place atoms on a sphere grid. Build up your molecules until they reach breaking point where they explode sending atoms flying over the grid converting enemy atoms to your own. Eliminate your friends' atoms through strategy and massive chain reactions.

467277.overview: Create music using a 3D module rack that contains tweakable sample players, sequencers and control modules. Play live with gamepads, drum kits, guitars or the pattern sequencers. Drums supports velocity sensitive input for nuanced performances. Connect cables between modules to control sample triggering, sequencing, surround sound and more. Supports split screen with up to four players.

467278.overview: The 80's super computer has taken over and is printing out an evil ascii army! Command the high tech dot matrix assault vehicle and get ready to kick some ascii in this retro style arcade action title.

467279.overview: The 80s super computer, 'Deep Thoughts', is back and printing another evil ASCII army bent on destruction. Assault the enemy in this original campaign featuring all new levels, additional enemies, and multiple game modes in this arcade action title with unique gameplay and retro style. Prepare for the ASCII invasion in 3 2 1 ... ATTANCK!

467280.overview: Audio challenge is a sound guessing game for 1 to 4 players. It is an excellent game for casual players, groups and family.

467281.overview: Grab some friends and play Ava Bash, a compilation of six button bashing games that will see who is the master of the control pad in your house. Includes a free bonus game.

467282.overview: Unite the forces of Fire and Ice to repel incoming magic attacks! Help Ice Mage Zaganos and Fire Mage Aruna complete their missions while defending the construction of the Sky City. Play through the story or compete against a friend in this fast-paced center-defence game.

467283.overview: In the world of Audiball, sounds become audible when tiny spheres known as "audiballs" pass through them. Use your guitar controller in a new and interesting way as you trigger sounds to guide the audiballs through each track, producing music as you go.

467285.overview: Go retro in this arcade action title with unique gameplay and visual style. The 80s super computer is printing an ASCII army and it's up to you to pilot the ASCII assault vehicle to put an end to the mayhem. Updated enemies, levels, and modes await you in this challenging game with retro controls and ASCII kicking style.

467286.overview: Help Ava rescue the fireflies and bring them back to the light. Share your high score over XBox LIVE with other players. Enjoy four rich scenes and see what level you can reach in this dreamy, neon-glowing chase game. Featuring music by "The Greatest Funeral Ever."

467287.overview: Help mother nature by rotating the leaves to point to the ground in this relaxing puzzle game. With soothing soundtrack and beautiful visuals, let this game help you be at peace.

467288.overview: Move over Minesweeper! AutoMorpion is the next big “little” game to hit the XBox. Simple to learn, almost impossible to master, instantly addictive. The farther you go, the harder it gets, so you have to keep thinking several moves ahead. And you have to keep out-doing yourself. All you do is just keep adding one more dot to connect five dots in a row. Easy, right? Until it starts to grow...

467289.overview: This is for all who find spirals mystical, perplexing and supreme. Indulge yourself in a million different whorls with this amusement. Impress your pals with screensaver mode (full version only). Unveil swirly classifications, surprise and taunt all with your discoveries, and send cryptic codes to your Xbox buddies (full version only)! Here's your chance to achieve digital knitter's utopia.

467290.overview: Travel through heaven, earth, hell and the etherworld in this retro styled platform adventure. Play as Aurelia, a voluptuous angel on a mission from God. Find power-ups, fight ghosts, goblins and evil wizards, Interact with comedic characters and unravel the greatest story ever told.

467291.overview: Take your Avatar hang gliding over beautiful islands and an active volcano. Race through Ring Rush, collect stars in Star Smash, hit your targets in Delivery Dash, or simply unwind and explore in Free Flight. Three unique settings and nine challenges, all with online scoreboards. Take to the skies TODAY!

467292.overview: “Combine and Control two characters simultaneously in a post-apocalyptic abstraction of the King Arthur Legend with a haunting metaphorical overtone.” - As Arthur the Exiled in a post-apocalyptic world, harness the powers of 4 different robotic companions, known as the “Knights of the Round” over 2 different modes, in a unique "Single-Player Co-operative" experience.

467293.overview: Experience a story filled with sexy and dangerous creatures in the third episode of Avalis Dungeon!

467294.overview: The sequel to the great Avatar hang-gliding game brings three new islands, varied skill level courses and split-screen play. Learn the secrets of the master gliders by following their ghosts shared online. Race through Ring Rush, collect stars in Star Smash, hit your targets in Delivery Dash, or simply unwind and explore in Free Flight. Take to the skies TODAY!

467295.overview: Experience a story filled with sexy and dangerous creatures in the second episode of Avalis Dungeon!

467296.overview: Test your precision and land on the target, or face certain death! Be careful with the variable gravity and wind and properly time your jumps! Swing through 30 levels of increasing difficulty, and climb up the global rankings! Experience thrilling multiplayer matches, both local and online!

467298.overview: Explore a deep and mysterious dungeon filled with dangerous and sexy creatures!

467305.overview: Audio Diagnostics contains a series of interactive tests to help you get the most out of your entertainment centers audio system. Audio Diagnostics will assist you in tasks such as setting up and positions your speakers, and gives you a rough idea of the overall quality of your audio system.

467324.overview: Avatar Alarm Clock transforms your Xbox into a fully featured alarm clock. Avatar Alarm Clock replicates the features of high end alarm clocks. Feature such as waking you up gradually by simulating a natural daybreak with light and sound. Also soothing you to sleep with a choice of ambient sounds and calming graphics. Feel comforted as you watch your Avatar sleep alongside you.

467325.overview: Avatar Adventurers is a Multiplayer Online RPG. Develop your avatar by levelling your character and obtaining new equipment. Battle formidable beasts, complete quests and take on missions across three vast continents. Communicate with fellow adventurers, form experience parties and trade items. Join the online adventure today!

467326.overview: Avatar and the Deadly Tomb is a hardcore vertical-scroller where you need to escape from an ancient tomb which turned out to be a deadly trap. Run as fast as you can, there is no time to wait! Only the best are able to beat this game!

467327.overview: Take your avatar to the skies in classic aerial dogfighting. Unlock a variety of aircraft including helicopters, jets, and space ships. Play offline against bots or online with up to 7 other players. Shoot down enemy aircraft and destroy enemy buildings to win the round.

467328.overview: Play the best Avatar Bowling game and have tons of fun with up to four of your friends. Will you get the best score to reach the top of the on-line high score board. Make a perfect game and be the best avatar bowling player of the world.

467329.overview: Avatar Bumper Cars is a 1-4 player arena battle game. Watch your avatar take control of a bumper car in one of 5 different arenas and face off against either your friends or the computer in an action packed battle! Use your car's spikes to hit their gas cans and send them flying out of the arena. Will you be the last man standing?

467330.overview: Do you always forget your friends birthday? Or did you ever miss an appointment? Now you can organize all your dates on your Xbox - with Avatar Calendar

467331.overview: 50 avatars can simultaneously bust out fly dance moves to Avatar Boogie's music, or to the music you already own! Choose from randomly-generated avatars, create your dance party, and watch them perform a variety of dances! Multiple dance arenas, tons of camera options, and slick dance moves await you in full 1080p resolution!

467332.overview: Player avatars lead a troupe of 100 other avatar dancers! Throw in 30 new dance moves, 11 new songs, 3 new dance floors, and adjustable strobe and colored lighting, and youll be tearin up the dance floor! Avatars can also dance to custom soundtracks a great way to play music at parties! Let your avatar unleash its dance moves in this awesome follow-up to the original hit, Avatar Boogie!

467333.overview: This is Bowman like you’ve never seen before! Set in a fully 3D medieval town you can fire arrows in any and all directions. Play against your friends, either locally or online, and watch your name climb the global high scores list as you amass wins! Nothing’s more satisfying than correctly adjusting for the wind and watching your arrow curve into the face of your foe!

467334.overview: "The Best Party game money can buy!" - Avatar Gamer Magazine. Knock other players out of the 4 different arenas while trying to stay inside! Features 6 Versus modes, gorgeous graphics, wacky powerups, endless customizations... Single and Coop modes included at no extra charge! At the same price than a cup of coffee, this tastes way better and lasts longer!

467335.overview: Bankers, you know you’re going to hell! But on the way there's still time to bankrupt a few countries and fill your pockets, you may even have time for a massage at the end of a hard day off loading your debts. A one to four player game where the only thing you have to do is ruin the world and live the dream! Play with a friend for ultimate enjoyment.

467336.overview: Compete as your avatar against the computer or a friend by trading arrows on the battlefield in this classic archery competition.

467337.overview:
Avatar Avenue is a simulation of a city street complete with randomly generated people, traffic and weather.

Avatar Avenue's AI engine not only ensures that the Avatars have unique appearances but unique behaviors as well. Avatars will react to everything around them including each other in interesting ways.

467338.overview: Avatar baseball is the original and funniest way to play baseball with your avatar. Face CPU or a friend and make as much runs as possible. Prepare your fingers for the action.

467339.overview: Avatar Aquarium is a delightful simulation of an aquarium. However this aquarium is filled with Avatars instead of fish. Watch Avatars swim around, feed them, and in the full version, drain the tank dry or go fishing! Avatar Aquarium’s Avatar generation engine makes sure that you have a different set of Avatars every time you play.

467340.overview: A first person shooter with avatars, featuring fast deathmatch gameplay on eight maps with jump pads, teleporters and a proven arsenal of energy weapons. Compete with other players in online multiplayer sessions or practice offline versus bots.

467341.overview: Avatar Battle Bees is an arena battle game for up to 8 players online, featuring both deathmatch and objective based game modes. Customise your avatar's own bee and battle it out against the AI in single player wave defense mode, or take on your friends with up to 4 player local and up to 8 player online combat!

467342.overview: Play as a native or a settler in a world of blocks to conquer the whole world for your own people. You can create block maps, play in single player and online multiplayer.

467343.overview: There is cash out there and it is up to your Avatars to battle it out and grab as much of it as you can. But hurry Avatar Cash Dash is a fast and frantic battle for glory. With 1 to 4 players it's a great game to play on your own or with friends. So thumbs at the ready there's cash to grab. 3-2-1 GO!

467344.overview: "Avatar Climbing" is a multiplayer action platformer that offers a multiplayer Score Attack Mode, single player Time Attack Mode, P2P Time Attack rankings, Course design support, and P2P sharing of courses.

467345.overview: Are you the next Bobby Fischer? Hone your skills against a computer opponent of selectable difficulty. Challenge someone in-house with one or two controller multiplayer, invite a player from your friends list to a private game, or take on a matchmade opponent over Xbox Live. View your game in traditional 2D, basic 3D, or crank up the fun by playing with Xbox Live avatars for pieces.

467346.overview: The Avatar Connection. The game show where you meet real people online with your Xbox Avatar.

467347.overview: How long can you survive dodging crates?

467348.overview: There is cash out there and it is up to your Avatars to battle it out and grab as much of it as you can. But hurry Avatar Cash Dash is a fast and frantic battle for glory. With 1 to 4 players it's a great game to play on your own or with friends. So thumbs at the ready there's cash to grab. 3-2-1 GO!

467349.overview: Avatar Deathmatch is a family-friendly multiplayer first-person shooter in which players, represented as their Xbox Avatars, battle each other in a colorful 3D environment. Although the weapons are based on real weapons such as handguns, uzis, and shotguns, they only shoot foam-esque projectiles which arc in the air, and players are 'knocked out' rather than killed. There is a god mode power-up that makes players invulnerable for a limited amount of time when collected. Each round lasts for 10 minutes and the player who has scored the most knockouts by the end of the round wins.

467350.overview: Avatar Dairansen is an arena style fighting game. Players choose the fighting style of their avatar with choices that include a kung-fu, ninja, samurai, and zombie style. Each style comes with a low and high projectile move and each character also has a dash and jump move, however performing a move will drain some energy that the move costs to do so the player can't constantly do the same move over and over until the move meter refills. The game also has destructible environments where the player can knock their opponent into a building. Players can also design their own arenas to do battle in.

467351.overview: Exciting bike races of your Avatar through mountains and forests, across lakes and tunnels, while avoiding obstacles and your opponents. Enjoy the 24 circuits and 6 game modes (Single Race, Time Attack, Racing for points and Tournaments), alone, against a friend in split screen or against the rest of the planet through Xbox Live.

467352.overview: Avatar Driving : Try out your driving skills in 5 game modes, Play through all 50 levels in 4 different environments. With the choice of 4 different vehicles.

467353.overview: Compete in intense penalty shootouts with teams from across Europe! Featuring both 2 player and against the AI modes.

467354.overview: Blackjack is the most popular casino game in the world! Now take your avatar into the exciting game of chance and skill. Play over Xbox LIVE and showcase your avatar as well as your stuff. Earn 12 in-game awards that unlock content to customize your game room. Whether you hit, stand, or double down, this game always feels like a winner.

467355.overview: Ever want to watch your Xbox Live Avatar plummet helplessly through the air and smash into things? Well now you can in the humorously cruel new game "Avatar Drop"! You and your friends can experience the side-splitting hilarity of watching your digital alter-egos bump, scream and crash their way through random obstacles.

467356.overview: Avatar Eras Online is a multiplayer RPG. Choose a class and level your avatar while developing the skills that you choose. Complete quests/challenges to obtain rewards and new equipment. Create high quality items by learning a craft and train your own pets. Form teams and trade items with fellow adventurers while making your way up the rankings to become the greatest avatar across the eras.

467358.overview: Avoid the obstacles that lie on the train cars. Jump the barrels of the right color, break the boxes and you will make more points! More barrels you will jump in sequence and multiply your score much more! Challenge your friends trying to make the highest record!

467360.overview: The ultimate First Person Shooter with Avatars returns for more action! Take your friends down on the battlefield!

467545.overview: Fight with monsters, cast powerful spells, loot magic items and save the innocent. Do it all playing as your Xbox LIVE Avatar! There's also special difficulty for hardcore gamers. All that for only 80 MSP!

467546.overview: The ultimate farming experience on your Xbox! This major overhaul to Avatar Farm features animals, farm expansion, online play, and improved graphics! Play with your friends and cultivate the best farm ever! This indie game has been developed by Milkstone Studios.

467548.overview:
Look out below! Avatars are falling everywhere!

Test your ragroll skills as you twist and tumble down flights of stairs using your custom XBox avatar.

467549.overview:
Can you tell the difference between fact and fiction?

In this simple quiz game you may always have a 50% chance of being correct, but how much do you really know? And will you crack under the pressure of the clock? Put your avatar to the test and see just how well you can do!

Features 3 challenging game modes, 3 levels of difficulty, in game statistics and of course avatars!

467551.overview: Cultivate your own farm: Plant crops & trees and take care of them as they grow!

467552.overview: A Shooter is a space based 2D side-scrolling flight game that over the course of 13 levels, pits the player's attack fighter up against waves of enemy fighters, with each level getting progressively harder. At the climax of each level, the player will be pitted against a boss. The player only has one life per game and it does not contain any king of visual health indicator. As with similar games, the player will receive points based how many enemies and bosses killed, the harder the enemies, the more points are awarded. High scores are also tracked globally. Throughout the game, power-ups can be obtained and collected, and unlike power-ups in most games they are permanent. A Shooter also features co-operative gameplay for up to four people.

467557.overview: Take your avatar on a scary journey through the ruins of a lost Mayan citadel. Team up with your friends in search of the sacred relics, but beware of the ancient creature that protects them...

467559.overview:
This is the game where you win by making your Avatar Fart!!

Multiplayer mode available so you can even fart with a friend!

467560.overview: Take on shot challenges across 16 unique stages. Compete alongside your friends in the multiplayer mode!

467561.overview: A fighting game with avatars... now with online multiplayer! Fight to become champion of the Avatar Fighter tournament! Choose out of eight characters, or use your own avatar as a custom fighter with a customizable move set!

467563.overview:
Score a Touchdown with your Avatar!

Features: 3 vs 3 Xbox LIVE Multiplayer, Full Season Mode, Design and Share your own Offense and Defense Plays, Customize and Share Rosters, and Much More!!!

Avatar Football is for gamers of all ages and skill levels.

467589.overview:
Challenge yourself in this ultimate reaction based game! Increase your reaction speed and reflexes by playing against other gold grabbers. Beat your friends in local and live games.

Will you become the Ultimate Gold Grabber?

467590.overview: The Avatar Worlds relics have been stolen by Galactic Templars and hidden throughout the galaxy. Now the world is crumbling around you, and time is running out! Travel to the far reaches of the galaxy to reclaim the relics and save the world of Avatars!

467593.overview: Race your avatar across 8 themed tracks against 7 other cars, including up to 3 of your friends. Use the power ups to help you by taking out as many of them as you can! There are tons of extras: Grand Prix mode, 1-player Time Trials, test drives, "insane" power ups, mirror and reverse mode, track records, ghost cars and many more. 4-player splitscreen with insane power ups has to be tried!

467594.overview: Hit the links as your Avatar in style. Features: Play as your Avatar, create and share courses over Xbox Live, 8 player online matches, unlockable titles, player statistics, course records, weather conditions and much more! With 9 uniquely themed 18-hole courses you'll have a blast playing Avatar Golf. Avatar Golf is for gamers of all ages and skill levels.

467595.overview:
The fastest, most exciting avatar racing game in the world is back for more with 12 themed tracks, 10 powerups, online multiplayer (up to 8 players) and splitscreen (up to 4 players).

Test your skills in a quick race, grand prix, time trial or test drive, and look out for "insane" powerups, mirror and reverse mode, track records, ghost cars, online best times, trophies and much much more!

Along the way, there are also items that periodically appear, and whoever grabs them can use them to attack the other players, such as by shrinking them or freezing them in place temporarily. Each player also has a limited boost meter which can be used to either move quickly to the sides or to jump, and will refill when not in use. The game ends when a player collects the golden milkshake, which is worth a points bonus but does not decide the winner outright.

467604.overview: The evil Teddy has kidnapped avatar twins from around the globe and it's up to you to free them from his devious clutches. Reunite the avatar twins and help them escape from the depths of Teddy's mansion! Stimulate your imagination and explore multiple thematic realms of mystery in your quest to free all avatar slaves!

467607.overview: Can you work out the phrase in order to save your avatar? Full version features include: 1000 phrases in 5 varied categories, access to your statistics and a system to avoid repetition of phrases. Includes support for the XBOX 360 Chatpad or USB Keyboard, and a variety of color schemes.

467609.overview: Give yourself a High Five. You deserve it. Includes 3D Mode!

467611.overview: Speed, explosions, amazing crashes and impossible jumps, discover what adrenaline feels like in Avatar Insane Race 3D. Do extreme acrobatics across 13 enormous scenes and 13 cars while you try to finish the race before time ends or driving across the impossible insane mode.

467612.overview: Jump as long/high as you can to grab the gold! Enjoy playing with up to 4 other players in this button mashing competition featuring your avatar. Share your score on line and see who's best jumper. Beat the long jump, triple jump and high jump world records. Or master the championship by winning all gold medals.

467618.overview: Battle against 15 other players in this World War II shooter featuring classic weapons of the day. Upgrade your weapons, earn perks and rewards while progressing through the ranks. COD players will feel right at home in this action packed game set in the streets of a European village.

467619.overview: Run as fast as you can to grab the gold! Enjoy playing with up to 4 other players in this button mashing competition featuring your avatar. Share you score online and see who's best. Beat the 110m hurdle world record! Master it with the 400m hurdle and compare your score with other people all over the world with the on-line leader board!

467636.overview: The hit racer of 2011 returns in full shape, with new karts, new tracks, and a major overhaul in all areas. Pedal to the metal!

467643.overview: Your friend has been kidnapped by one of the worst Gang of the city. Obviously they did not know that you are a Kung Fu Master. One thing is for sure : They're gonna pay for it! Fight against boss of each level and their minions to rescue your friend. Easy to play, hard to master, be one the top online score board of the most addictive beat-them-all on XBLIG.

467658.overview: Show your pride and test your karate skills on the roof, on the playground or in the dojo. Challenge 20 different opponents to become the new karate champion. You can battle against up to three other players on your console or around the world via Xbox LIVE. Pick up various powerups to boost your abilities. Switch to anaglyph stereoscopic 3D for playing in a real three dimensional environment.

467660.overview: Go karting with your avatar! Put the pedal to the metal and drift your way to the checkered flag on 16 twisty circuits. Challenging AI, online multiplayer, global rankings, Turbo Boost, rewind function, and more, from the creator of Avatar Racedrome.

467665.overview: Play classic lasertag with your avatar online against your friends or offline against computer controlled opponents. Battle it out in team versus team mode or in free for all where everyone is out for themselves. Games can be played indoors or outdoors in both daytime and nighttime modes.

467666.overview: Defend the space station with your trusty blaster or a host of automatic laser weapons. Play online against your friends or offline against computer controlled opponents. Rank up to unlock weapons and perks in this all out laser attack!

467667.overview: Take your very own Avatar into an online Laser Tag arena with 16 of your closest friends (or enemies). Compete head to head with up to 16 players to see who can become the ultimate Laser Wars champion. Avatar Laser Wars features a full 3D multilevel environment, multiple weapon unlocks, battlefield power-ups and portals! Compete with the rest of the world with the global high-score list.

467668.overview: Play online with up to 15 of your friends in Avatar Laser Wars 2 the sequel to the hit game by DigitalDNA Games, and one of the most advanced first person shooters to hit Xbox Live Indie Games. Unlock multiple of weapons, grenades, perks and killstreak awards as you work your way through the player ranks. Compete online with a global high score list.

467669.overview:
Avatar Legends 2360 is an action-RPG featuring big guns, big enemies, and a big city to explore!

You and up to 3 other players can team up online to fight against the nastiest creatures in the galaxy. Upgrade your weapons and skills on your way to becoming a true soldier. Create your own adventures and share them with the world.

Lock and load, because the battle for Avatar City has already begun!

467670.overview: The sequel nobody has been waiting for is finally here! Guide your avatar through all new mazes while collecting coins and stars along the way.

467672.overview: Avatar Mayhem is a build and destroy sandbox featuring an urban world to use as your scratch pad. Create structures, fly around with your jetpack or demolish everything. Defend against an alien invasion in City Defense mode.

467673.overview: It's... AVATAR MAN. Survive the hordes of avatars that guard the forbidden labyrinths! Outrun and outsmart your opponents!

467674.overview:
Finally, a massage app with avatars and online play! A perfect solution for long-distance massage buddies or anyone who's just dying for a soothing massage.

We here at JForce Headquarters are experts on rumble technology, and we're pushing the limits. This means you can actually get the maximum vibration out of your controller! MASSAGERRIFFIC!!!

467675.overview: Are you ready for the ultimate head to head mental challenge? Test your recall by matching the avatars you reveal with their twins or triplets. 1-16 players supported with many many options.

467678.overview:
Meet up with other gamers or bots and interact with your avatar!

Show off your avatar's earned and purchase clothing to old friends, or make new ones! Chat live with your Xbox 360 headset and control your avatar's actions for everyone to see.

This is the ultimate avatar experience, don't miss out.

467680.overview: A.M.P offers you the ultimate Block-Shooter with over 15 maps, including tributes to greatest FPS titles of all time! Rockets, Mines, Shotguns and more await in the classic Battle game types, but also in the most powerful Map editor ever created. Construct with the most blocks ever seen in any Block Game, and share with your friends. Zombie Survival Mode coming next update!

467682.overview:
Loop the loop with your Monster Truck!

Ride through all the obstacle courses, and beat the developer ghost record.

467706.overview: EXTREME NINJA POWER! You're now travelling around the world searching for a challenge. Unleash your new ninja skills in the improved training courses!

467707.overview:
Avatar Ninja is a game that, as the title may suggest, tests the ninja skills of the player's Xbox Avatar. The player's avatar is constantly running down a river on the top of the water, and there are two bars to keep track of. The red bar is the rhythm bar, and the player must continually press the A button to keep it filled. The blue bar is the focus bar, which goes down when the player hits an obstacle, and will slowly refill over time. The lower the focus bar is, the faster the A button must be pressed to fill the rhythm bar, and if the rhythm bar empties, the game is over.

There are several types of obstacles along the way. Logs must be jumped over with X, bombs must be slid under with B, and targets must be shot down with a shuriken using Y. There are also many coins that that must be collected for points, as well as several ninja magic powers the can be collected to give an ability like a focus boost or shield. The level increases after set distances, increasing the speed and difficulty of the game until inevitable failure.

467708.overview: Explore your surroundings, search for weapons and try to survive the night. Use your Avatar and join your friends with 2-8 player online cooperative play or PvP.

467709.overview: Avatar Onslaught pits the player against an endless army of advancing Xbox Avatars in a water balloon fight. The player must throw balloons at the advancing avatars before they reach the red line on the ground, while also avoiding the balloons they are throwing at the player's avatar. There are several types of enemies, as well as destructible shields that will protect the player from enemy balloons and can also be repaired. Between waves, the player can choose from a number of upgrades, including reload speed, throw speed, and ammo count. If five enemy avatars reach the player, the game is over.

467710.overview: Brace yourself for a massive onslaught of evil avatars. Take on the horde alone or get help with the online CO-OP mode. Level your character and compete against the world with global scoreboards. See you on the battlefield!

467711.overview: Prepare yourself for an almighty Onslaught. Take on hordes of avatars in full HD as you compete against the best in the world. Onslaught - BLIZZARD features character leveling, global scoreboards and Avatars.

467712.overview: Try this frantic space shooter with eight action packed levels! Fight against tons of enemy waves to progress in levels. Destroy the Planetoid that contains the bonuses and at last, destroy the core!

467713.overview: Avatar Panic rejuvenates an Arcade classic, now in Full HD! Pop bubbles with your harpoon while avoiding being hit by them! Includes an Arcade mode with 50 levels, and Panic mode for fast-paced games! Play alone or cooperatively with your friends and try to achieve #1 world ranking!

467714.overview: Avatar Paintball is a simple third-person shooter that pits players' Xbox Avatars against each other in a friendly game of paintball. Players roam around a small cartoon town filled with obstacles and powerups, shooting each other for points. There are four types of paintball guns with different attributes, and in addition to the online play for up to 16 players, there is also a training mode where the player has a limited amount of time to shoot targets strewn about the map.

467715.overview: Replay the world cup matches with Avatar Penalty Kick! Will you be the best scorer?

467716.overview: Ragdoll physics meets classic pinball gameplay in a giant pinball machine where your Avatar is the ball!

467717.overview: Take part in a tense penalty shootout with your avatar. Compete against AI or take on a friend and see if you can become the penalty shootout master! Quick fire fun for all the family.

467718.overview:
Running is hard! Can you reach the finish line?

Features avatar ragdoll physics.

467719.overview:
Ready for extreme planking? You’ll plank in places you’ve never dreamed of! Plank inside a taco, on a cat’s stomach, or even on Mars!

Over 60 crazy locations, famous landmarks, and beautiful vistas await your avatar in Avatar Planking! Don’t forget to make a silly face for the camera!

467721.overview: Get your Avatar into the autumn spirit and have a smashing good time too! Ghoulishly throw pumpkins at other Avatars to score the most points within the time limit. Play in teams or everyone for themselves. Each map can be played during the day or at night if you dare. You are even treated to power ups. Play against computer controlled fiends or play online against friends or enemies.

467722.overview: An adventurer lost on a mysterious island faces the dangers of a runic quest. Every game is different! Lots of replay value with 186 random levels. Test your mental agility while the time is running out!

467723.overview: Compete with your avatar to manage to be the best boxer of all times across his 4 game modes or fight against a friend!

467724.overview:
Avatar Puzzle Pop is a frantic and fun action puzzler. Connect two groups of blocks of the same colour to remove them from the play field. Combo blocks together for big points.

Avatar support for fun gameplay feedback. Multiple game modes, clear the line, disarm the bombs, shoot some dice and play a friend in 2 player mode.

467725.overview: Think you are the genius of the household? Put your Avatar on the stage and your quiz knowledge to the test with up to three other contestants. Will you be the laughing stock, or win the adulation of the crowd? With over 1000 questions and online high score tables we will soon find out who is the smartest cookie in the jar. Big Button controllers are compatible with Avatar QuizCall.

467727.overview: Take your avatar for a rollercoaster drive at the Racedrome! Battle it out on 16 twisty tracks with fierce computer opponents, or online over Xbox LIVE. Includes a rewind feature so you can retry those risky maneuvers.

467728.overview: The hit game Avatar Quizcall is back to brighten up your holiday season, step up to the stage and take part in the ultimate holiday quiz. With one to four players, global highscore tables and region specific questions. It's not a party unless it's a Avatar Quizcall party, let's see who is the smartest cookie in the jar.

To use this service you must buy this app and have an Xbox Live Gold subscription and a Mic or Headset.

467730.overview: Everybody loves ragdolls. Throw your funny avatar rag-doll higher and higher. Play alone or with up to 4 friends. See your avatar fall, rebounce and climb up to the victory.

Run to your own music library with a custom run and compete against friends through tournaments.

See you on the high score table! (Big Button compatible) It's not a party unless it's a QuizCall party!

Stop an onslaught of angry Avatars by...typing? Logical enough! Can you type the sentences you're given before the enemies cross your path?

Featuring 8 enemy types and 2 modes of play, the action is sure to last. With over 1,500+ sentences to type and the ability to create your own, you're almost guaranteed to develop a fun case of carpal tunnel!

Chatpad or Keyboard required.

467749.overview: Game, Set & Match! Experience the most spectacular matches with Avatar Tennis! Train your skills, unlock over 50 rackets and get to the top rankings in the complete Career Mode, and take part in exciting local games of up to 4 players.

467750.overview: Your Avatar is stuck in a burning tower! Flee from the fire by jumping the platforms. Make combos and collect stars to gain higher scores. Try to break your own highscore!

467751.overview:
Unleash your Inner Ninja! Avatar Trials: Ninja Uprising is a third person platforming game. Using parkour and free running movement, use your Avatar to navigate three challenging levels influenced by Assassin's Creed and Ninja Warrior.

You've never seen Avatars like this before - Master your skills to become a true ninja!

467752.overview:
Hit the slopes with your avatar. Enjoy breathtaking 3D HDR scenery, awesome 3D physics, hundreds of millions of levels, and more!

Snowboard alone or with a friend split-screen style. You have but one goal - make it to the bottom of the mountain.

Oh, and don't worry about calling for a pick-up. You are equipped with an infinite rocket booster should you need a push. Use with caution!!

467761.overview:
Shoot hoops with your avatar to be the best scorer in the world!

Six courts and six different game modes are waiting for you in the first "basketball" game with zombies on it!

Sound like a real pro with SuperTune automatic tuning technology. Are you the next Avatar Superstar?

ROCK NOW BELONGS TO THE AVATAR!
